jobs.title: PROGRAM COORDINATOR
jobs.description:
**The Opportunity**

Come join our team! Homeward Bound helps unsheltered individuals and families in Marin County transform their lives through housing, training, and supportive services.

Homeward Bound is Marin County’s primary provider of shelter and housing for individuals and families experiencing homelessness. We offer emergency shelter, short- and long-term supportive housing, job training and placement, and wraparound services. Our mission is **Opening Doors to Safety, Dignity, Hope, and Independence**.

We are seeking a **Program Coordinator** to join our Nuestra Casa Family Program.

**Principal Responsibilities**

* Provide housing-focused case management for participants of Nuestra Casa Family Program.
* Facilitate client groups and events across the team’s housing portfolio.
* Incorporate **intensive care coordination and housing stabilization strategies** into individualized housing and care plans, in collaboration with healthcare, behavioral health, and community-based partners.
* Identify and address barriers to housing stabilization, including chronic homelessness, mental and physical health needs, substance use disorders, under-employment, lack of income, and other systemic barriers.
* Skillfully prevent and/or resolve conflicts skillfully using a strengths-based approach.
* Respond to urgent and crisis situations, including coordination with EMTs, fire, law enforcement, psychiatric services, and community partners as needed.
* Prevent and resolve conflicts using a strengths-based, trauma-informed approach.
* Provide supportive services, guidance, and referrals to community resources.
* Engage program participants regularly and consistently to support program participation and progress toward housing stability.

**Documentation and Compliance**

* Complete timely, accurate, and compliant documentation, including billable case notes, assessments, care plans, and progress updates, in accordance with policies and funder requirements.
* Ensure client records clearly demonstrate eligibility, service delivery, engagement, and progress toward housing, health, and personal goals.
* Maintain accurate and timely data entry in HIPPO (Salesforce database) and HMIS.
* Meet all documentation and case management deadlines, including intake, enrollment, reassessments, housing goals, and discharge documentation.
* Participate in quality assurance, monitoring, and audit processes, including responding to documentation reviews and corrective actions.

**Case Management, Housing-Focused Services, and Outcomes**

* Develop, implement, and regularly update individualized, client-centered housing and care plans.
* Monitor, document, and adjust plans proactively to address changing needs or barriers.
* Coordinate services with internal teams and external partners to ensure continuity of care and timely referrals.
* Document housing and service outcomes to support program performance measurement and funder reporting.
* Develop, implement, and monitor financial literacy services tailored to covering topics such as budgeting, credit repair, savings strategies, and employment preparedness.
* Assist program participants in housing retention, job readiness skills, job placement and retention services, education on living skills, navigating resources and referrals, eviction diversion, and addressing physical and mental health issues.

**Property Management and Housing Placement**

* Assist the Senior Director of Family Programs and Program Manager with client identification and screening for housing eligibility, leasing, and client move-ins
* Assist the Senior Director with refining program policies and practices, unit setup and purchasing, and facility troubleshooting
* Promptly submit documentation to the Marin Housing Authority for the issuance of client vouchers and rental calculations/recalculations as needed
* Assist with property management, including but not limited to creating and tracking maintenance requests, maintaining site presence across the housing campus, tracking client rental payments, issuing legal notices, and documenting tenancy challenges
* Proactively monitor building needs, perform rounds, coordinate closely with facilities

**Professional Standards and Team Collaboration**

* Manage a full caseload and bi-weekly/monthly meetings, with strong organization, time-management, and prioritization skills.
* Communicate clearly and professionally with supervisors, team members, volunteers, agency partners, and program participants.
* Participate in weekly supervision, program meetings, all-staff meetings, and required training.
* Maintain confidentiality and comply with all agency policies, including HIPAA where applicable.
* Contribute positively as a collaborative, accountable member of the Homeward Bound team.
* Strong organizational skills

**Minimum Qualifications**

**Education / Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in social work, psychology, social welfare, or a related field **OR** three (3) years of experience in a related residential or housing program.

**Experience & Knowledge**

* Minimum of three (3) years’ experience working with under-resourced or low-income populations; experience working with individuals experiencing homelessness preferred.
* Experience in residential and/or housing programs.
* Knowledge of Housing First and harm-reduction principles.
* Working knowledge of SSI, SSDI, and SDI.
* Working knowledge of local resources for low-income individuals.
* Experience with data entry systems (HMIS, Salesforce, or similar).

* Comfort working in a culturally and ethnically diverse environment.
* Working knowledge of substance dependence disorders and mental health disorders.

jobs.title: Part Time Crossroads Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Marin Academy**

**Part-Time Crossroads Program Coordinator**

**Second semester of the 26-27 School Year**

Marin Academy seeks an experienced Educator or Program Coordinator for a part-time, after-school Program Coordinator position from
 **January 5th-May 28th, 2027.**

**Position Schedule:**

* 10 hours/week throughout the semester.
  
* Non-exempt hourly position. Compensation $28 - $33/hr.
  
* Mondays 3 - 6 p.m., Tuesdays 3–5 p.m., Thursdays 3-5 p.m.
  
* An additional 3 hours per week will be scheduled for meeting and prep time. These hours can be flexible.
  
* There will be 2-3 weekend and evening commitments throughout the semester (family workshops, field trips, celebrations, etc.).

**Overview of the Crossroads Program:**

Crossroads is an after-school program for sixth-, seventh-, and eighth-grade students attending public middle schools in San Rafael. Students apply to the program at the beginning of their 6th-grade year and commit to it for three years. The major objective of Crossroads is to equip students with the skills they need for success in middle school, high school, college, and beyond. We believe these students are at an important crossroads in their lives, and we are committed to providing them with the support, skills, and information to improve their access to educational opportunities. For more information about Crossroads, please visit
our website.

  

Crossroads is a program of Marin Academy, an independent, college preparatory high school located in San Rafael, CA, with an enrollment of approximately 450 students with academic talent, interest in the arts and athletics, and a passion for a multitude of issues. The Crossroads program was born out of Marin Academy’s mission statement, which “asks every individual to think, question, and create in an environment of encouragement and compassion, and challenges each person to accept the responsibilities posed by education in a democratic society.” The school is a vibrant and diverse community, and students and teachers alike continue to work towards furthering an inclusive and supportive school. Marin Academy students participate as tutors and teachers within the Crossroads after-school program. Marin Academy is an equal-opportunity employer, and people of color and women are encouraged to apply. For more information about Marin Academy, please visit our website (
www.ma.org
).

**Position Description & Qualifications:**

Crossroads seeks an experienced, professional candidate who is both organized in their ability to coordinate an after-school program and skilled in working with high school and middle school students. The Crossroads Program Coordinator will spend about 40% of their time organizing program logistics in the Crossroads office on the Marin Academy campus and 60% of their time providing direct service during our after-school program on Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday afternoons. The Crossroads Coordinator will also do supply runs off-campus and ride the bus with students as needed. If the program is virtual at any time, the Crossroads Coordinator will support and facilitate Crossroads sessions online. Candidates must be personable, organized, independent, creative, flexible, and cooperative.

  

**Minimum Requirements**
 **:**

  

* Ability to communicate with both adults and students effectively
  
* Commitment to social justice, anti-racism, and equity in education
  
* Strong organizational skills
  
* Experience with basic computer software (Zoom, MS Office, Google Docs, Internet, Email)
  
* A valid driver’s license and willingness to drive students in school vans
  
* A valid driver’s license to do supply runs to local stores (Target, Costco, Michael’s Craft Store, Safeway, etc.)
  

  

**Desired Qualifications**
 **:**

* Spanish-speaking and writing fluency (ability to make phone calls in Spanish and translate documents)
  

  

**How to Apply:**

  

Interested applicants should submit a résumé and cover letter to the ADP site on our web page: http://www.ma.org/careers

jobs.company: Asian Americans for Civil Rights & Equality (AACRE)
jobs.title: SFILEN & SFRRN Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
### **Position Summary:**

The Program Coordinator supports the San Francisco Immigrant Legal and Education Network (SFILEN) and the San Francisco Rapid Response Network (SFRRN) by coordinating partners on grant and contract administration, meetings, and network-wide programming. The Program Coordinator occasionally fills shifts on the SFRRN Hotline, coordinates logistics and develops content and materials for reports, events, campaigns, and social media.

### 

### **About Chinese for Affirmative Action (CAA)**

CAA was founded in 1969 to protect the civil and political rights of Chinese Americans and to advance multiracial democracy in the United States. Today, CAA is a progressive voice in and on behalf of the broader Asian American and Pacific Islander community. CAA advocates for systemic change that protects immigrant rights, promotes language diversity, and remedies racial and social injustice.

### 

### **About SFILEN and SFFRN**

The San Francisco Immigrant Legal and Education Network (SFILEN) and the San Francisco Rapid Response Network (SFRRN), are two leading immigration legal service networks in the City. Since their founding in 2006 and 2008 respectively, both networks have paved the way as successful models for multi-ethnic, multi-lingual, multi-strategy coalition building to advance immigrant rights and immigrant access to legal services.

  

The San Francisco Rapid Response Network (SFRRN) is a 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, immigration enforcement response hotline serving the City of San Francisco. Founded in 2008, and revamped in 2016, SFRRN was one of the first, and remains one of the few 24/7 immigration enforcement response hotlines in the country. SFRRN houses 8 immigration focused community based organizations who staff the 24/7 hotline, verifies immigration enforcement activity in San Francisco, connects San Franciscans to legal and accompaniment services, and provides immigration centered Know-Your-Rights to immigrant community members citywide.

  

In 2026, CAA became the lead and fiscal agency to house SFILEN and SFRRN. As a founding and active member of these networks, CAA is committed to the health and wellbeing of both collaboratives in order that partners may continue to serve immigrant communities with immigration legal services and community education in the face of heightened immigration enforcement and rising xenophobia.

  

### **Position Description**

Program Coordinator coordinates partners in both SFRRN and SFILEN in relation to administration of grants and contracts and network wide programing including regularly scheduled meetings, special events, and campaigns. The Program Coordinator also coordinates logistics, and develops content and materials to support the advancement of SFILEN and SFRRN including for reports, events, campaigns, and meetings. The Coordinator works to ensure alignment and accessibility of information for all network partners and relevant stakeholders. The Program Coordinator will also assist the SFRRN Manager in supporting hotline services including receiving hotline calls, conducting follow-up, and coordinating with partners to respond to incidents of immigration enforcement.

**Key Responsibilities**

*Administrative Support for SFRRN & SFILEN Grants and Contracts*

* Communicate regularly with partners in Spanish and English about administrative requirements, reporting, and deadlines associated with funder compliance.
* Support grant and contract management through monthly data entry, compilation of partner reports, and tracking of services rendered by partners.
* Work closely with the SFILEN and SFRRN Program Managers and the AACRE Capacity Team to ensure timely reporting, invoicing, and submission of funder-required documents across all funding sources.
* Take notes at SFILEN and SFRRN meetings, conduct post-meeting follow-up, and share out notes.
* Document trends from meetings and partner reports, and identify opportunities for systems improvement.
* Transcribe all Rapid Response Hotline calls, tracking and documenting trends and identifying opportunities for systems improvement. (SFRRN)

*Programmatic Coordination of SFILEN and SFRRN*

* Support program logistics and communications for both Networks, including email reminders and coordination of monthly calls, and meetings.
* Support logistics, coordination, and planning for annual programming. This includes Immigrant Family Day, International Migrants Day, budget advocacy, retreats, trainings, and other Network-wide events and activities.

*Content and Material Development*

* Create visuals, infographics, and digital media for SFILEN and SFRRN events, campaigns, programming, and meetings. Examples include fliers, one-pagers, advocacy and fundraising materials, toolkits, and communications content.

  

*Data and Research*

* Provide timely data from SFILEN and SFRRN’s work to respective Network staff, partners, and funders, and articulate and document analyses and impact of such data.
* Assist with the collection, and coordination of data retrieved from other related immigration networks, such as the California Coalition for Immigrant Justice (CCIJ), the San Francisco Immigrant Legal Defense Collaborative (SFILDC), and other partners including intakes, statistics, reports, and referrals to inform SFILEN and SFRRN’s work.
* Conduct and/or coordinate research projects on immigration trends, immigration policy changes, relevant community resources, and other subjects.

  

*Translation*

* Translate communications and notes between English and Spanish to ensure accessibility of information across Network partners.

  

*Rapid Response Network*

* Serve as a dispatcher on the Rapid Response Hotline, where back-up is needed. This includes answering hotline phone calls, triaging emergency immigration situations, completing intake forms, and communicating with various stakeholders to coordinate service referrals.

Diamond Foundry Inc. is solving the thermal limitation at the foundation of today's most exciting tech industries - AI & cloud compute, electric-car power electronics, and 5G/6G wireless. We have managed to produce the world's first single-crystal diamond wafers and are now on a mission to put a diamond behind every chip. We are the rare unicorn that has grown fast and profitably. We received $515m in funding and are executing a multi-$B expansion plan for one of the greenest forms of tech manufacturing: converting greenhouse gas into diamond wafers using zero-emission energy.

Diamond Foundry is seeking a People Partner to support our Bay Area Diamond Foundry locations and our direct-to-consumer brand, VRAI.

The ideal candidate has supported both a shift-based and a corporate or customer-facing population and is comfortable moving between a production floor and a showroom in the same week. They are hands-on, practical, and credible with frontline managers. This is a role with room to grow, working closely with the VP of Human Resources on more complex matters.

### **Responsibilities**

* Partner with managers across diverse teams on daily people matters—including performance, attendance, and team dynamics—coaching them to conduct difficult conversations, resolve issues consistently, and document properly rather than handling matters on their behalf.
* Support employee relations by conducting independent investigations and collaborating closely with the VP of HR on complex or sensitive matters.
* Support multi-state accommodation and return-to-work processes in coordination with People Operations.
* Drive compensation and leveling initiatives, including new hire offers, promotions, and the annual merit cycle.
* Tailor and translate company-wide programs to effectively suit both shift-based manufacturing and retail environments, accounting for how different populations experience shared policies.

### **Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience with 4+ years in an HR or People Partner capacity, featuring hands-on employee relations experience (HR certification is a plus).
* Proven experience supporting both a non-exempt, shift-based workforce and a corporate or customer-facing population.
* Working knowledge of California employment law—particularly regarding leave, accommodation, and wage-and-hour requirements—with multi-state exposure preferred.
* Demonstrated track record of coaching managers, applying consistent standards across varying team cultures, and exercising sound judgment on when to act independently versus when to escalate.
* Experience navigating and building out processes within an evolving, high-growth environment (desirable).

The position is eligible for company shares. Actual compensation may be higher or lower in the range based on various factors, including, but not limited to a candidate’s job duties, experience, and location. We will also consider higher-level candidates and salary will be adjusted accordingly.

Diamond Foundry is an Equal Opportunity Employer and considers qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity and expression, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected factor under federal, state or local law.

**Working for Pacific Service Credit Union**

We put people first. That includes our members, our employees and the communities we serve. We hire energetic and enthusiastic people who want to work as part of our team.

**What’s in it for you?**

Health insurance coverage: We provide our employees with 100% premium employer-paid medical, dental, vision, disability and basic life insurance for full-time employees and a low monthly premium for eligible dependents.

401k: We contribute 3% of your base salary to your 401k account regardless of whether you contribute or not. In addition, we match 75% of your contributions up to the first 3% of eligible compensation beginning after your first day of employment and up to 6% after three years of service. All employees are vested at 100% for the employer match beginning the first day of employment.

Bonus program: All employees are rewarded for attaining our annual organizational goals.

Tuition Reimbursement program for employees eligible after six months of service.

Recognition program where employees can be nominated by management, their peers or by members.

Employee referral bonus.

Student Loan Repayment Assistance: Contributions toward your student loans every month by the credit union after six months of service.

Employees are eligible to receive a consumer loan rate discount

Vacation and sick time: Full-time employees receive more than two weeks’ vacation per year, 11 paid holidays and 10 days of sick leave.

**Our Hiring Process**

We believe it’s important for you to know where you stand in our hiring process. Below is an outline of the steps we take to make the best hires possible.

Apply: Submit your resume for one of our job openings.

Our Talent Team and our partner – Total Quality Consulting (TQC Team) will review your submitted information and will call or email successful applicants for an interview as soon as possible.

In-Person Interview: After a screening call with TQC, we’ll invite a final number of candidates to our office for an in-person interview or set up a live Zoom meeting with the hiring manager(s).

If we believe that you have what it takes, we'll make an offer and provide next steps in the hiring process!

This is a part-time position working 20 hours per week (4 hours per day).

* Analyze member needs and identify solutions through our robust products and services to strengthen the member’s financial future of those you assist while achieving established goals.
* Deliver excellent service while assisting members and non-members with routine account maintenance inquiries including general inquiries, transaction support, and fraud-related concerns.
* Protect the credit union and members by actively identifying, mitigating, and preventing fraud, account takeover, and identify theft activities.
* Assist members with digital banking needs, providing clear, guided explanations of how to self-serve, and effective navigation of PSCU’s digital banking technologies.
* Build and maintain lasting relationships with members through strong interpersonal skills, effective communication, and trust.
* Maintain a thorough understanding of the credit union’s products and services, and clearly articulate features, requirements, and benefits.
* Understand and comply with all applicable federal and state laws and banking regulations, including those related to Bank Secrecy Act (BSA), OFAC, and anti-money laundering, as well as PSCU’s policies and procedures.
* Identify and recommend opportunities to streamline or improve work processes and environments, as well as embrace the evolving technology and tools used to assist members.

Description:

The Assistant Case Manager supports the Case Manager in providing compassionate, person-centered services to individuals experiencing homelessness who reside in St. Vincent de Paul of Alameda County’s emergency shelter. The Assistant Case Manager helps strengthen the department’s capacity to serve shelter guests by providing direct client support, resource coordination, housing-navigation assistance, documentation, and administrative follow-through.

Working under the direction of the Case Manager, this position assists guests in identifying and accessing community resources and services that support housing stability and overall well-being. The Assistant Case Manager will work with individuals who may be experiencing complex barriers, including mental health challenges, substance use disorders, domestic violence, unemployment, lack of identification or documentation, and other challenges that may affect their ability to obtain and maintain stable housing.

The ideal candidate is compassionate, dependable, organized, resourceful, and comfortable working with individuals from diverse backgrounds. jobs.title: Senior Data Operations Manager
jobs.description:
**About Genesis**
=================

We are a full-stack general-purpose robot company, born across San Francisco and Paris and bound by a single mission: to make general-purpose robots a reality, unlocking infinite physical labor for the world and freeing people for creativity, exploration, and the pursuits they love for their own sake.

We are French and American by birth and global by nature. We are backed by partners who share our vision, including Eclipse, Khosla Ventures, Bpifrance, and HSG, alongside Eric Schmidt, Xavier Niel, Daniela Rus, and Vladlen Koltun. Our people work across the Bay Area and Europe, building the engine that will teach robots to do real work in the real world. We recently unveiled Eno, our wheeled, dexterous robot powered by our GENE foundation model, and we are starting to put it to work with real customers.

**The role**
============

The hardest part of building general-purpose robots is not the model. It is the data: real, dexterous, physical-world manipulation that does not live on the internet. Our unlock is a data-collection glove built to the exact geometry of our robot hand, unobtrusive enough that a person can wear it through a normal workday, so ordinary work becomes training data that transfers to the robot without loss. Paired with our own hardware, simulation, and models in one tight loop, that is the most scalable manipulation data engine in the world.

This is the role that runs that engine on the ground. You will own the system that turns stations, workforce, and facilities into one reliable operation, end to end, from the operator at the station to the accepted hour that lands in training. You will grow it from a single floor into a global, multi-shift operation that holds a world-class quality bar as it scales. We are looking for someone who has run data collection at scale and is hungry to do it again at the frontier of physical AI.

**What you'll do**
==================

* **Run the floor end to end.** Own scheduling, operator utilization, station uptime, and the throughput that delivers accepted hours at the quality bar, every week.
* **Build the operator bench.** Recruit, level, and develop operators and the senior operators who run shifts, until the team is deep enough for multiple shifts and multiple sites.
* **Hold one standard everywhere.** Make every floor we run and every partner site collect to the same playbook, the same metrics, and the same bar.
* **Turn problems into process.** Root-cause what slows the floor and ship the SOPs, layouts, and tooling that make the next site ramp faster than the last.
* **Partner on quality and annotation.** Work hand in hand with the Quality and Process and Annotation functions so collected hours convert cleanly into training-ready data.
* **Stand up partner-site collection.** Rehearse and run the mock-runs and first deployments that bring partner operators onto our gear.
* **Report the truth.** Build the reporting that tells the company, honestly, what we collected, at what quality, and at what cost.

**What we're looking for**
==========================

* **You have built data collection at scale, and it shows.** You have run a teleoperation, glove, or human-data operation at a frontier robotics lab, an embodied-AI company, or a top data operation, and you know the difference between hours collected and hours that actually train a model. There is a short list of places this work happens. If you have done it, we want to talk.
* **Throughput is in your blood.** Scheduling, utilization, yield, and the hundred details of a working floor are second nature.
* **Quality is never optional.** You have run an operation where the bar was real and measured, and you held it without slowing the line.
* **You run through walls.** Bias for action, deep ownership, and a refusal to wait for permission. You see what needs doing and make it happen.
* **You build teams that win.** You hire well, coach honestly, and people do their best work for you.
* **You work across sites and cultures.** You are comfortable partnering with our teams and sites in Asia and Europe, and operating across time zones.

**How we work**
===============

We are always looking for people who are driven to work on hard problems and want to shape what the world will look like in ten years. A few of the values that guide us:

* **Limitless ambition.** We hold ourselves to the highest bar in everything we build.
* **Relentless urgency.** Iterate faster, learn faster. Time is the denominator.
* **Type-2 Fun.** Take the work seriously, not yourself. Embrace the grind and find joy in the struggle.
* **Radical transparency.** Candid communication builds trust, and direct feedback drives growth.
* **Multiculturalism.** We come from across the world. Be curious. Meet people on their terms.
* **Team over ego.** Help others, share context, and win as a team.
* **A joyful journey.** We take pride in the craft, enjoy the ride, and make space to laugh. Happiness is part of how we get there.

jobs.description:
### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 2 years of experience in program or project management.
* Experience integrating generative AI tools or Large Language Model (LLM) interfaces into workflows.
* Experience as a clinical research associate in sponsor-initiated clinical research operations.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* 2 years of experience managing cross-functional or cross-team projects.
* Experience in user experience research and ophthalmic optics, including a strong understanding of ophthalmic terminology, lens measurements, prescription interpretation, and optical measurements and equipment.
* Experience in consumer electronics, or wearables technologies.
* Familiarity with hardware development cycles and processes.

**About the job**
-----------------

A problem isn’t truly solved until it’s solved for all. That’s why Googlers build products that help create opportunities for everyone, whether down the street or across the globe. As a Program Manager at Google, you’ll lead complex, multi-disciplinary projects from start to finish — working with stakeholders to plan requirements, manage project schedules, identify risks, and communicate clearly with cross-functional partners across the company. Your projects will often span offices, time zones, and hemispheres. It's your job to coordinate the players and keep them up to date on progress and deadlines.

As a Clinical Program Manager at Google, you will work with stakeholders to deliver on clinical outcomes and manage device use in alignment with clinical compliance requirements. You will plan study requirements with internal engineering teams and usher user evaluations through the entire product lifecycle. This includes managing Institutional Review Board (IRB) compliance, coordinating laboratory workflows, and communicating with project stakeholders.

You will be responsible for driving the day-to-day operations and logistics of clinical studies, serving as the primary liaison between study sites, managers, and regulatory bodies. Key duties include managing IRB submissions, maintaining the Trial Master File (TMF) to ensure GCP compliance, and coordinating the distribution of investigational devices and study supplies. Additionally, this role oversees subject enrollment tracking, monitors Case Report Form (CRF) data quality, and ensure all participant data, informed consent forms (ICFs), and Adverse Event (AE) reporting are accurate, legible, and fully compliant with ALCOA+ source documentation principles inside the Trial Master File (TMF).

The Platforms and Devices team encompasses Google's various computing software platforms across environments (desktop, mobile, applications), as well as our first party devices and services that combine the best of Google AI, software, and hardware. Teams across this area research, design, and develop new technologies to make our user's interaction with computing faster and more seamless, building innovative experiences for our users around the world.

  
Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.
  
  
US: $132000 - $189000 (USD) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits  
  
Learn more about benefits at Google.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Manage day-to-day ophthalmic Rx program and device logistics and Collaborate with cross-functional partners including Clinical, Research Scientists, UX Researchers, Hardware/Software Engineering, and Regulatory to track program and study requirements, maintain schedules, and monitor study-readiness and compliance criteria.
* Manage study workflows by coordinating human subject test execution, managing evaluation logistics, and supervising clinical participant and laboratory logistics alongside research scientists and program stakeholders.
* Identify risks, blockers, and changing timelines early (such as recruitment bottlenecks, site enrollment delays, or regulatory hurdles), working alongside Program and Clinical Leads to triage operational issues.
* Contribute to team operational excellence by supporting clear clinical program tracking mechanism.
* Manage administrative and operational program overhead, including compiling resource demands, drafting program-related status reports.

jobs.title: Executive Operations & Office Manager

jobs.description:
Develop Health is on a mission to use AI to radically accelerate access to life-saving medications. By automating complex, manual healthcare processes—like benefit verification and prior authorization— **we've been growing rapidly and over the past couple of years have helped over 3.6 million patients!**

We’re partnering with some of the largest pharmacy benefit managers and payers in the nation, revolutionizing how healthcare interactions occur by eliminating human delays and inefficiencies. Our small, elite team of founders and engineers have previously launched and exited successful healthcare startups including Rupa Health and Canvas Medical. We are now scaling rapidly following a major funding round.

**The Role**
------------

Our executives spend their days building the product and closing deals with the biggest names in healthcare and life sciences. You'll keep everything around them running smoothly, while also ensuring our offices are productive, collaborative places to work that celebrate our team.

65% of your time goes to supporting our CEO, CTO and Chief Commercial Officer: their calendars, travel, meetings and relationships, plus the culture work that keeps our team connected. The other 35% goes to employee engagement and running our core office in San Francisco and satellite office in Menlo Park. You'll report to our Senior Manager, Strategy & Finance.

You’ll be the first full-time partner to our leaders, able to unlock a new level of focus and support. You’ll help us optimize our Menlo office, including transitioning it to a smaller satellite space in mid-2027, while helping us open and optimize our new, San Francisco office in January 2027.

The role is a match for someone who solves problems creatively, keeps finding better ways to do things, and has a gift for hospitality. As the company scales, special projects and increased responsibilities are likely. This is a great entry point into the company, and will give you visibility into the full business.

**What You’ll Do**
------------------

**Support our C-Suite**

* Own their calendars. Expect lots of external meetings, tricky scheduling and plans that change daily.
* Work with our Sr. Manager of Strategy and Finance to build agendas for team and leadership meetings, help run them, and capture notes and action items.
* Plan on-site and off-site meetings, dinners and team events.
* Book complex travel for our executives, arrange travel and accommodation for visitors coming to Develop Health, and prepare expense reports.
* Be the face and voice of Develop Health as you reach out on behalf of our team, and help us build great relationships with senior leaders at our partners and customers.

**Build our culture**

* Company-Wide: Nurture our fast-paced, collaborative, and active culture with team gatherings, lunches, and celebrations.
* For Individuals: Partner with our People and Talent team to bring the magic to onboarding, work anniversaries, birthdays, and special milestones.

**Run our offices**

* Set up both offices to be productive, collaborative workspaces that folks are excited to come into each week: choose and manage vendors, organize the spaces, and create our office manual, routines and protocols.
* Keep the SF office clean, organized and ready for the team. That means non-janitorial tidying of common areas, meeting rooms, the kitchen and storage.
* Keep us stocked with everything from stationery to snacks, drinks and coffee.
* Coordinate team lunches, and set up for special events and All Hands.
* Troubleshoot Zoom and Google Meet room devices, room booking tablets, and AirPlay or cable connections for all hands meetings.
* Handle mail, packages and shipping for the team.
* Be the main contact for office vendors, including catering, building management and maintenance.

**About you**
-------------

* You’re excited to work onsite in San Francisco, Tuesday through Thursday each week, with a day in Menlo Park every other week to ensure that office is flowing. Time in Menlo may decrease as we transition this to a satellite office.
* You have 3+ years supporting a senior executive at a fast-paced company
* You've worked in office management, workplace experience or operations.
* You can juggle many requests that each feel urgent to the person asking. You prioritize, keep people updated, and get it all done without losing your cool.
* You move fast and make decisions on the spot without missing details. When things are ambiguous or changing, you stay calm and keep your sense of humor.
* You set a high bar. Nothing gets dropped, and our executives trust your work completely.
* You're AI-native. You use Claude to work faster, and you bring the judgment, taste and human touch that make every message feel thoughtful and polished.
* You're a straight shooter. If you disagree, you say so up front. If the answer is still no, you commit and make it happen.
* You spot needs before anyone asks and find solutions on your own.
* You're warm and welcoming, communicate clearly, and work well with all kinds of personalities.
* You're strong in Gmail, Google Calendar, Sheets, Slides, Excel and PowerPoint, and you can set up basic office A/V with confidence.
* You're reliable and punctual. You're online and responsive during business hours, closing loops to keep the team’s work flowing.

**Bonus points**
----------------

* You already have a system for supporting a busy executive team and running an office.
* You have experience in business operations, recruiting or HR and can help support the other biz ops staff

Compensation Range: $75K - $90K

jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description:
**Position Summary**

The Project Manager is responsible for managing architectural signage projects from contract award through design, fabrication, installation, and final closeout.

This position coordinates customers, general contractors, designers, production teams, installers, and vendors to ensure projects are completed on schedule, within budget, and to our quality standards.

Successful candidates will be comfortable managing multiple projects simultaneously, anticipating problems before they occur, and taking responsibility for meeting project commitments.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Project Planning & Scheduling**

* Develop and maintain detailed project schedules with clearly defined milestones and deadlines.
* Coordinate design, permitting, procurement, production, and installation activities.
* Identify potential delays, material shortages, and scheduling conflicts before they impact project delivery.
* Monitor project progress and take corrective action when schedules are at risk.
* Coordinate resources and priorities with production and installation teams.

**Customer & Contractor Communication**

* Serve as the primary point of contact for customers, general contractors, and other project stakeholders.
* Lead project kickoff meetings and provide regular progress updates.
* Establish clear expectations and maintain strong customer relationships.
* Resolve project issues promptly and professionally.
* Identify, document, and manage changes in project scope through formal change orders.

**Production & Installation Coordination**

* Review project drawings, specifications, and shop drawings for accuracy and completeness.
* Ensure production teams receive clear, complete, written instructions before work begins.
* Coordinate material procurement, subcontractors, and fabrication requirements.
* Verify field conditions and installation readiness.
* Coordinate installation schedules and resolve field issues.
* Ensure finished products meet customer expectations, quality standards, and applicable code requirements.

**Budget & Project Controls**

* Establish and manage project budgets.
* Monitor project costs and identify potential overruns.
* Manage purchasing and subcontractor costs in accordance with company procedures.
* Coordinate progress billing with accounting.
* Maintain accurate project records, documentation, and change orders.

**Project Closeout**

* Coordinate final inspections, punch lists, and customer acceptance.
* Ensure project documentation and closeout requirements are completed.
* Resolve outstanding issues and support continuous improvement.

**Qualifications**

**Required**

* Experience managing commercial construction, architectural signage, specialty fabrication, or similar projects.
* Strong project planning, scheduling, and organizational skills.
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple projects and competing deadlines.
* Ability to read and interpret construction drawings, specifications, and shop drawings.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
* Ability to coordinate effectively with customers, vendors, production personnel, and installation teams.
* Proficiency with project management software and Microsoft Office applications.

**Preferred**

* Experience in architectural signage, environmental graphics, or custom manufacturing.
* Familiarity with commercial construction processes and general contractor requirements.
* Knowledge of ADA signage requirements, permitting, and installation practices.
* Experience with ERP systems such as NetSuite.
* Experience managing project budgets, subcontractors, and change orders.

What We're Looking For

We value Project Managers who:

* **Plan ahead:** Develop realistic schedules and actively manage milestones.
* **Take ownership:** Accept responsibility for project commitments and results.
* **Communicate proactively:** Keep customers and internal teams informed without waiting to be asked.
* **Solve problems:** Identify risks early and develop practical solutions.
* **Stay organized:** Maintain accurate schedules, documentation, and project records.
* **Work collaboratively:** Build positive relationships across departments and with customers.
* **Deliver quality:** Take pride in completing projects correctly, on time, and within budget.

**Our Values**

Corporate Sign Systems operates with integrity and respect in all relationships with customers, vendors, the community, and each other. We foster a climate encouraging innovation, collaboration, and professionalism.

We are looking for individuals who demonstrate these values through their work, communication, and relationships.

Pay: $80,000.00 - $95,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance

Experience:

* project management: 3 years (Required)

Ability to Commute:

* Santa Clara, CA 95050 (Required)

Work Location: In person

**Location:** San Francisco, CA (Main Office)

**Employment Type:** Full-Time Salaried

**Reports To:** Operations Manager

**About WestRock Engineering**

WestRock Engineering is a San Francisco based general engineering firm specializing in underground utility infrastructure for public works and Capital Improvement Program (CIP) projects throughout the Bay Area. Since 2024, we've built a reputation for reliability, precision, and technical excellence in delivering the infrastructure that keeps our communities running; including water mains, sewer systems, storm drains, and dry utilities.

We partner with municipalities, water districts, and public agencies across Northern California to execute complex infrastructure projects on time, on budget, and built to last. We recognize that while underground utility work is behind the scenes, its impact on the community is vital and we take pride in doing it right the first time.

At WestRock, we invest heavily in our workforce. We foster a collaborative culture that emphasizes hands-on mentorship, professional development, and clear pathways for career growth.

**Position Summary**

WestRock Engineering is seeking an experienced Project Manager to lead public works and underground utility construction projects from contract award through closeout. The Project Manager is accountable for each project's schedule, budget, safety, quality, and contract administration and serves as the primary point of contact for clients, public agencies, subcontractors, vendors, and field teams.

**Key Responsibilities**

· Manage assigned underground utility and civil construction projects from notice to proceed through closeout.

· Develop and maintain project schedules, budgets, and cost forecasts, and report on financial performance.

· Serve as the primary liaison for public agency owners, inspectors, engineers, subcontractors, and field teams.

· Review plans, specifications, and contract documents for compliance, constructability, and potential risks.

jobs.description:
Title: **Senior Program Manager**

Location: **South San Francisco**

Type: **Full-time / On-Site**

Ohalo is hiring a Senior Program Manager (PM) to lead strategic programs across the organization. You will run cross-functional programs that span Biotech R&D, engineering, and operations. You will take complex initiatives from concept to delivery.

This is a full-accountability leadership role. You will act as general manager for a set of high-impact programs. You will own outcomes, set strategy, and direct work across technical and business teams.

This role requires strong program management fundamentals and a track record of leading complex, cross-functional initiatives. You should be a strong leader and systems thinker who is motivated to build AI apps and agents that keep work running continuously.

The ideal person thrives in a high-ownership, fast-moving environment and is excited by leading complex, high-stakes initiatives from ambiguity to execution. AI is changing how biological discovery and development get done. We want someone who will lead that change, not wait for it.

**Responsibilities:**

**Program General Management & Accountability**

* Own program success for one or more strategic, cross-functional programs.
* Design and implement scalable processes and methods for planning, execution, and tracking.
* Drive alignment with stakeholders and executive leadership. own decisions, escalations, and accountability.
* Own budgeting, forecasting, and analytics of managed programs.

**Cross-Functional Execution & Communication**

* Build and maintain integrated program plans that connect workstreams across teams. Make dependencies and critical paths explicit, and manage them.
* Define how each program fits together: workstreams, interfaces, handoffs, and validation. Keep teams executing to one integrated schedule.
* Make the call on trade-offs and escalations; drive alignment across scientists, operators, and executive leadership without waiting for consensus.
* Spot bottlenecks early and unblock teams through clear priorities and fast follow-through.
* Translate technical complexity into clear artifacts for audiences ranging from scientists to Ohalo's board.
* Use AI as a force multiplier that runs program work, continuously (tracking, reporting, follow-ups), not one-off analyses or reports. Hold a high bar for accuracy and traceability.
* Hold the team to the same standard and help each member build AI into how they work.

  

**Qualifications:**

* 8+ years of experience leading cross-functional programs in R&D, Engineering, technology, operations, or a related field.
* Strong engineering fundamentals, with experience taking technical work from design through deployment.
* Hands-on with AI and eager to go further: you use AI tools in your daily work and want to build apps and agents that run work continuously, not just one-off analyses or reports.
* Strong systems thinker. Comfortable working across disciplines and turning ambiguity into executable plans.
* Track record of leading cross-functional teams and delivering on timelines and commitments.
* Proven ability to influence without authority and build alignment between technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* High-ownership leader who is energized by mission-driven work and follows through.
* First-principles thinker who questions "how it's always been done" and isn't afraid to redesign a process.
* A Bachelor's degree is required, ideally in a technical discipline. An advanced degree is preferred
* Experience in a scientific, technical, or engineering environment is required.

Founded in 2019, Ohalo develops novel breeding systems and improved plant varieties that help farmers grow more food with fewer natural resources, increasing the yield, resiliency, and genetic diversity of crops to sustainably feed our population. Ohalo's breakthrough technology, Boosted Breeding™, will usher in a new era of improved productivity to radically transform global agriculture. For more information, visit www.ohalo.com.

About Second Harvest of Silicon Valley  
Founded in 1974, Second Harvest of Silicon Valley is one of the largest food banks in the nation and a trusted nonprofit leader in ending local hunger. The organization distributes nutritious groceries through a network of nearly 400 partners at drive-thru and walk-up sites across Santa Clara and San Mateo counties. Due to the prohibitively expensive cost of living in Silicon Valley, the economic downturn caused by the COVID-19 pandemic, and the rise in inflation, Second Harvest is now serving an average of about 500,000 people every month. Second Harvest also connects people to federal nutrition programs and other food resources, and advocates for anti-hunger policies on the local, state and national levels. To learn more about how Second Harvest is responding to the incredible amount of need in Silicon Valley, visit shfb.org.

About the Position  
The main responsibilities of this role include developing expertise within a particular geographical region, forming deep community relationships, and managing food distribution programs to provide ongoing nutritious food access for low-income individuals and families. Regional Program Managers are experts in their region and act as a primary liaison for a portfolio of 501(c)(3) nonprofit partners and Second Harvest programs. The role manages relationships, ensures collaboration with partners, develops alignment between organizations, and optimizes the food distribution process while leveraging all resources effectively. jobs.title: Deployment & Engagement Operations Lead
jobs.description:
**Who We Are**
--------------

Physical Intelligence is bringing general-purpose AI into the physical world. We are a group of engineers, scientists, roboticists, and company builders developing foundation models and learning algorithms to power the robots of today and the physically-actuated devices of the future.

**The Team**
------------

This role sits in Research Operations and works closely with partnerships, research, hardware, and infrastructure. Partnerships sets the terms of each engagement and research owns the technical goal. This role owns everything it takes to deliver operationally, from the point an agreement takes shape through completion.

This role requires sound judgment, comfort with ambiguity, and a strong sense of ownership. You will start as a hands-on individual contributor, build the playbook for how PI runs external engagements, and grow the team that supports future partners and deployments.

**About the Role**
------------------

As our work scales, more of it happens alongside external partners and at deployment sites. Each engagement brings its own site, schedule, stakeholders, and constraints. The Deployment & Engagement Operations Lead makes sure these engagements are scoped, staffed, resourced, and delivered successfully, so research and engineering teams can stay focused on the technical work.

**In This Role You Will**
-------------------------

* Own operational scope, resourcing, and execution for external engagements and deployments, from kickoff through completion.
* Translate partner commitments into execution plans that define milestones, owners, staffing, robot allocation, and site requirements.
* Lead complex, long-running engagements involving multiple teams, evolving requirements, and significant operational responsibility.
* Build trusted relationships with partner stakeholders and work through their requirements, approvals, schedules, and site constraints.
* Stand up new sites, bringing together operators, fleet support, equipment, logistics, and site access.
* Plan staffing and coverage across robots, shifts, and locations, and step in directly on site when needed.
* Drive readiness ahead of key milestones, including dry runs, bring-up checks, inventory, and fleet and infrastructure coverage.
* Prioritize and allocate robots, people, and support across concurrent engagements, and flag when a commitment needs to change.
* Keep partners, researchers, and leadership aligned on status, risks, escalations, and decisions.
* Build repeatable playbooks and processes, and grow the team that carries them forward as the work scales.

**What We Hope You'll Bring**
-----------------------------

This role sits at the intersection of program management, field operations, and partner delivery. We're looking for someone who has owned operational outcomes on the ground, can lead several engagements at once, and can step into whichever one needs attention.

* 5+ years of experience in program management, field operations, technical project management, or similar roles.
* Track record of launching and running physical operations, such as opening new sites, markets, or facilities, leading hardware deployments, or running on-site programs for enterprise customers.
* Experience owning delivery of external partners or customer programs end to end.
* Experience staffing and leading teams across shifts and locations.
* Ability to quickly understand technical goals and work through tradeoffs with researchers, engineers, and external partners.
* Strong judgment under pressure, including knowing when to escalate and when to push back on commitments we cannot keep.
* Willingness to travel frequently and work extended stretches on site.

**Bonus Points**
----------------

* Experience supporting AI, robotics, autonomous vehicles, or hardware organizations.
* Experience working within large enterprise partner environments, including confidentiality, approvals, and site access requirements.
* Experience turning one-off launches into a repeatable operating motion.
* Experience building operational processes and scaling teams.
* Familiarity with robotics workflows and teleoperation environments.

Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

jobs.title: Customer Success Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Job Description:**

The **Customer Success Coordinator** is an experienced professional who owns the day-to-day coordination and operational execution of defined customer success workflows. The role ensures customer commitments, feedback, and cross-functional actions are documented, analyzed, routed, and completed, and recommends practical improvements when processes or outcomes are not meeting expectations.

  

Reporting to the Senior Manager of Customer Success, this role works independently on varied issues that require judgment, evaluation of available information, and adaptation of established approaches. Work is reviewed at key points. The coordinator partners with Customer Success, Sales, Product, Engineering, Operations, and senior internal and customer stakeholders, tailoring communication to the audience and helping influence timely resolution of customer priorities.

  

The role also supports Voice of Customer programs, including NPS and other customer feedback initiatives, and turns customer input into clear themes, reporting, and recommendations for improvement.

  

**Responsibilities**
====================

  

**Customer Coordination and Issue Resolution**
----------------------------------------------

  

* Own tracking and follow-through for customer commitments, decisions, risks, and action items across assigned initiatives; identify delays and drive clear next steps with accountable partners.
* Coordinate customer-related work across Sales, Engineering, Product, Operations, and other teams, ensuring requests and concerns reach the right owners and receive timely attention.
* Assess unusual or cross-functional issues, gather and evaluate available information, identify likely causes or gaps, and recommend a course of action; escalate material risks when needed.
Facilitate internal and customer-facing discussions as appropriate, adapt communication to differing audiences, and explain customer priorities in a way that supports alignment and resolution.  

  

**Documentation and Knowledge Management**
------------------------------------------

  

* Maintain accurate customer records, meeting outcomes, decisions, and supporting documentation so teams can access reliable, current information.
* Maintain and improve customer success knowledge resources in Confluence and create or manage Jira tickets for customer requests, initiatives, and follow-up work.
* Apply consistent documentation practices and identify information gaps or process variations that could affect customer outcomes or execution.
* **Voice of Customer and Reporting**
  -----------------------------------
* Coordinate NPS and other customer feedback activities, including survey setup, distribution, response tracking, and follow-up using SurveyMonkey or similar tools.
* Organize and analyze customer feedback and operational data to identify recurring themes, emerging concerns, and opportunities for improvement.
Prepare clear reports and recommendations that communicate customer sentiment, relevant context, and potential actions to Customer Success and cross-functional partners.  

  

**Operational Improvement and Program Support**
-----------------------------------------------

  

* Own assigned Customer Success reporting and operational tracking, ensuring information is accurate and deadlines are met.
* Prepare materials and coordinate inputs for customer business reviews and internal planning meetings.
* Evaluate existing workflows and recommend or implement practical improvements that strengthen efficiency, accountability, and customer experience.
Contribute to special projects and initiatives, adapting established approaches to address changing needs and incomplete information.  

  

**Qualifications**
==================

  

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Customer Success, Customer Operations, project or program coordination, account coordination, or a related professional role.

* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to facilitate meetings, document decisions and actions, and adapt communication to different internal and external audiences.
* Experience partnering across teams and building productive relationships with stakeholders, including senior partners or customer contacts.
Proficiency with Confluence and Jira, and strong working knowledge of Microsoft Office and/or Google Workspace.  

  

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

  

* Experience supporting Customer Success or other customer-facing teams.
* Familiarity with NPS programs, customer experience practices, and customer feedback analysis.
* Experience with SurveyMonkey or similar survey platforms and CRM tools such as Salesforce.
Exposure to SaaS, technology, or service-based organizations.  

  

**What Success Looks Like**
===========================

  

* Customer commitments, risks, and action items are accurately documented, assigned, and completed on time.
* Cross-functional partners have clear visibility into customer priorities, owners, and next steps.
* Customer feedback is organized, analyzed, and communicated with useful recommendations.
* Customer records and knowledge resources remain accurate, consistent, and easy to use.
Assigned workflows and programs run reliably, with practical improvements that strengthen accountability and the customer experience.

jobs.title: Manager, GMP Quality Assurance
jobs.description:
CSBio is a peptide contract manufacturing founded in 1993. CSBio initial products were a complete line of automated synthesizers for manufacturing and process development, with a focus on cGMP production. In 1994, CSBio opened a custom peptide facility and began producing high quality compounds for research organizations and pharmaceutical companies worldwide. In 2004, CSBio opened a peptide production facility in Menlo Park, CA and in 2014, CSBio expanded production capability through the addition of a new, state of the art building dedicated to cGMP peptide production. In 2017, CSBio passed a FDA inspection and were recommended to be approved for commercial drug substance manufacturing. In 2023, additional cGMP clinical production capacity was added in Milpitas, CA.

CSBiois seeking a hands-on Quality Assurance Manager to supervise daily QA activities supporting peptide manufacturing, laboratory operations, materials, documentation, and cGMP compliance. This person will manage QA staff and directly support document review, deviations, CAPAs, change controls, training, batch-record review, audits, and inspection readiness. Core duties and responsibilities include the following:

**Job Duties:**

* + Supervise daily QA work, assign priorities, review completion, train staff, and provide practical guidance on cGMP documentation and quality-system requirements.
  + Review executed batch records, laboratory records, equipment and cleaning records, logbooks, labels, and supporting documentation for completeness and compliance.
  + Manage or support deviations, investigations, CAPAs, change controls, nonconformances, complaints, and effectiveness checks; ensure actions are documented and completed on time.
  + Coordinate document control, SOP issuance, periodic review, archival, forms, templates, and controlled-copy practices.
  + Support employee training assignments, completion tracking, qualification records, and documentation of GMP readiness.
  + Partner with Manufacturing, QC, Materials, Facilities, Validation, Regulatory, and management to resolve quality issues and prevent avoidable delays.
  + Provide QA review and approval of validation plans, risk assessments, protocols, reports, and qualification documentation for facilities, utilities, equipment, processes, cleaning, analytical methods, and software systems.
  + Work with system owners to maintain a practical validation assessment plan and address gaps in current or legacy validation documentation using documented risk-based decisions.
  + Support supplier qualification, material-status decisions, quality agreements, vendor documentation, and supplier corrective actions as assigned.
  + Manage or support customer-complaint investigations and approved recall or product-withdrawal procedures, including documentation, reconciliation, and authorized notifications.
  + Conduct or coordinate internal audits, floor observations, documentation reviews, and follow-up of findings.
  + Prepare QA records and subject-matter experts for customer audits and regulatory inspections; track requests, responses, observations, and commitments.
  + Monitor practical QA metrics such as overdue investigations, CAPAs, change controls, document reviews, training, batch-record review, and recurring documentation errors.
  + Escalate product-quality, patient-safety, data-integrity, compliance, and release risks promptly to authorized Quality leadership.
  + Improve QA workflows, templates, training, and quality-system usability without transferring QC laboratory or Manufacturing ownership into QA.

  
**Requirements**  

* Bachelor’s degree in life sciences, chemistry, engineering, pharmacy, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.
* 5+ years of Quality Assurance or closely related cGMP experience in pharmaceutical, biotechnology, peptide, API, sterile, medical-device, or other regulated manufacturing.
* 2+ years of supervisory, lead, or functional-management experience, including work assignment, training, review, and employee development.
* Hands-on experience with deviations, CAPAs, change controls, document control, training, batch-record review, audits, and inspection readiness.
* Working knowledge of cGMP documentation, data integrity, traceability, quality risk, and cross-functional escalation.
* Working knowledge of applicable FDA and ICH expectations and risk-based validation practices.
* Strong judgment, written communication, investigation, organization, and follow-through skills.

  
**Benefits**  

* Medical, dental, and vision insurance (Kaiser HMO or BlueShield PPO. Employer pays 85% for Employee and 50% for Employee’s family; Dental: Aetna Dental, Delta Dental, Guardian Dental, MetLife Dental. Vision: VSP and Aetna EyeMed)
* Basic life ($20,000 paid by company) and supplemental life insurance (optional supplemental).
* Disability insurance 50% standard employer paid.
* 401k 10% 1:1 match
* PTO policy. 10 days PTO
* Companywide paid holiday during: Week of July 4, Thanksgiving (2 days), Week of December 25
* Carpool, clean air vehicle, and cell phone reimbursement
* Employee rewards and recognition program
* Company organized social events
* Quarterly sponsored team building activities

jobs.description:
At Braze, we have found our people. We're a genuinely approachable, exceptionally kind, and intensely passionate crew.

We seek to ignite that passion by setting high standards, championing teamwork, and creating work-life harmony as we collectively navigate rapid growth on a global scale while striving for greater equity and opportunity – inside and outside our organization.

To flourish here, you must be prepared to set a high bar for yourself and those around you. There is always a way to contribute: Acting with autonomy, having accountability and being open to new perspectives are essential to our continued success.

Our deep curiosity to learn and our eagerness to share diverse passions with others gives us balance and injects a one-of-a-kind vibrancy into our culture.

If you are driven to solve exhilarating challenges and have a bias toward action in the face of change, you will be empowered to make a real impact here, with a sharp and passionate team at your back. If Braze sounds like a place where you can thrive, we can't wait to meet you.

**WHAT YOU'LL DO**
------------------

* Own Operational Processes: Own and continuously improve the operational processes and business requirements within the ES and PS divisions. Serve as an expert in Services Process best practices, with strong knowledge of the B2B SaaS business operations that underpin a CX Services group (e.g., services scoping and delivery, partner enablement and qualification, resource and capacity planning, and services revenue and utilization), to proactively identify bottlenecks and manual pain points, and design scalable solutions that drive efficiency.
* Deliver Operational Improvement: Lead high-impact operational programs that improve business processes and ensure alignment with departmental and company OKRs.
* Establish Data-Driven Excellence: Collaborate with the Data Engineering Enterprise Platform team (DEEP) to establish and maintain reporting frameworks that provide senior leadership with actionable insights into operational efficiency. Champion a data-driven approach, empowering teams to leverage analytics to inform their daily operations.
* Cross-Functional Leadership: Act as a trusted advisor and liaison between the CX business and key operational and technical teams. This includes regular partnership with leaders in CX business divisions and serving as a liaison with our Program Management team.
* Influence Stakeholder Partnerships: Build and maintain strong, collaborative relationships with other departments, including GTM Operations (to define and drive best-practice frameworks), and the CBO Enablement team. Collaborate with the Business Systems (BZS) team, including Salesforce Administration to support the prioritization of key initiatives for Support and Services.
* Solution Design: Liaise closely with the BZS team, building well-honed specifications and requirements documents from business cases, then working with BZS to generate elegant, scalable technical solutions. You will be responsible for defining the "what," "why," and contributing to the "how" of systems implementation. Work with Growth Engineering teams to design and build AI solutions that improve efficiency within an Operations environment.
* Change Management: Help build the change management strategy for new processes or systems, including leading internal documentation efforts and partnering with the CBO Enablement team to ensure organization-wide training and adoption.
* Technical Acumen: Possess an advanced understanding of the systems and tools used by CX, including Salesforce and other relevant platforms. Be comfortable with complex datasets and advanced analytics to support strategic process analysis.
* Lead Through Influence: Bring strong leadership qualities to a role without direct reports, working closely with both upstream and downstream teams to guide decisions, build alignment, and foster a culture of continuous improvement.

**WHO YOU ARE**
---------------

You are a solutions-focused subject matter expert in CX Operations, with a strong command of B2B SaaS business operations for CX Services organizations. You are a passionate, methodical problem-solver with a profound knack for translating complex operational challenges into clear, actionable plans.

* You have a proven track record of designing and delivering operational programs that have resulted in meaningful efficiency improvements.
* You possess an independent and results-oriented mindset, are methodical in your approach to identifying systemic challenges, measuring impact, and tracking key metrics, and have a proven ability to lead and inspire others.
* You have exceptional written and verbal communication skills, and are comfortable presenting to and influencing senior stakeholders.
* You are inquisitive about new technologies, and you always want to 'get under the hood' to see how your team could potentially benefit from early adoption.
* You are a highly collaborative individual, able to build consensus and align multiple senior stakeholders and both upstream and downstream teams toward a common goal.
* You are a completer/finisher who is comfortable working autonomously and taking the initiative to drive efficiencies and streamline operations on a global scale.
* You have strong experience with datasets and advanced data analysis using industry tooling, and advanced proficiency with Salesforce.
* You have a strong work ethic and take full responsibility for resolving complex issues with minimal guidance from your manager.
* 5+ years of relevant experience in an Operations or Process Improvement role, preferably within a SaaS company. Preferably 3-4 years of experience with B2B SaaS business operations supporting a CX Services group, including professional/expert services delivery, partner services and partner programs, client implementation, and technical support workflows.
* A proven ability to manage complex, divisional projects and operational excellence

**Location/Hours:**

* The typical weekly schedule is as follows:
  + Fall Term: Tuesday through Saturday (3x a month); Monday through Friday (1x month).
  + Spring Term: Tuesday through Saturday (3x a month); Monday through Friday (1x month).
  + Summer Term: Monday through Friday.
* In-person attendance is required for all Saturday programming dates and four days a week during the Summer Term.
* Work requires local travel beyond the office for Saturday programming at the following location (subject to change):
  + UC Law San Francisco, 200 McAllister St, San Francisco, CA 94102

**ABOUT SEO**

We Propel Human Potential. SEO is an educational non-profit focused on improving outcomes for students that come from underserved and historically underrepresented backgrounds. For over 50 years, SEO has been an innovator in education, mentorship, and creating educational programs and opportunities that maximize the full potential of our students. We are on a mission to create an ecosystem of excellence for the students we serve!

SEO Scholars provides motivated, low income public high school students with a rigorous out-of-school supplemental academic curriculum, college guidance and the leadership development necessary to gain admission to, and succeed at, competitive colleges and universities. SEO Scholars San Francisco is the first expansion region for this program and aims to replicate for Bay Area students the stellar outcomes that the program has delivered in New York City. (Learn more here: SEO Scholars)

**POSITION OVERVIEW**

With a portfolio of operational, strategic, and student-facing responsibilities, the Program Manager role provides the opportunity to make an impact both organization-wide and in direct service.

The Program Manager is responsible for advising and managing a cohort of up to 60 high school Scholars in their third year in the SEO Scholars program (rising 11th grade summer through end of 11th grade spring). This includes (1) building and maintaining a culture of high achievement and a supportive, family-like community that ultimately drives student performance in high school, and (2) leading students through programming (including mentoring and advisory curriculum) that will directly contribute to superior high school performance, in preparation for successful admission to competitive four-year colleges and universities. It is our goal to send 100% of our high school graduates to competitive four-year colleges and universities for free.

**Responsibilities:**

* Lead and implement SEO Scholars programming on Saturdays, after school, and during the summer. This includes designing and delivering Opening Circles and Advisory lessons, collaborating with instructional staff who serve your assigned cohort of Scholars. and co-facilitating the 11th Grade Mentor sessions.
* Monitor the performance and engagement of all Scholars in assigned cohort; track and analyze Scholar attendance, assignment completion, assessments and grades in SEO Scholars classes, high school courses, community college courses, and standardized test scores. Use data to drive advising discussions with Scholars
* Create and nurture an inclusive environment that encourages intellectual curiosity, academic excellence, and college readiness.
* Collaborate with co-11th Grade Program Manager on college advising curriculum creation and adaptations to meet overall 11th Grade advising strategy
* Provide data-driven academic advising and appropriate psychosocial guidance to all Scholars in cohort; monitor student attendance, participation, and performance at SEO and in high school; consult with Associate Director of Program to refer out to other agencies as necessary
* Support Manager of Mentoring and Enrichment Programs in managing mentor program- recruit, select and pair volunteer mentors with 11th Grade Scholars
* Collaborate with co-11th grade Program Manager and Manager of Mentoring and Enrichment Programs to ensure successful application cycle and strong Enrichment Program placement for all 11th graders
* Manage dual enrollment partnership opportunities for cohort through communication and collaboration with relevant staff.
* Serve as primary parent contact for 11th grade students in your cohort and their families; leverage data and learning partnerships to conduct individual and group parent meetings to foster Scholar’s successful completion of the program.
* Facilitate instructor check-in meetings to gather information about Scholar performance and advise on action plans to support Scholars.
* Collaborate with 10th and 12th grade staff to transition Scholars into and from the 11th grade each summer.
* Foster and maintain relationships with parents, school partners, volunteers, and corporate partners.
* Assist with the planning, coordination, and supervision of occasional trips (e.g. college tours).
* Effectively manage data in alignment with 11th grade goals and outcomes.
* Other duties as assigned.

**QUALIFICATIONS**

* Bachelor's degree required
* Direct experience working with high school-age students. 2+ years’ public teaching/counseling experience strongly preferred.
* Experience in student coaching and advising, including interfacing with parents and families.
* Evidence of progressive career growth within roles increasing in responsibility and autonomy.
