jobs.title: Strategic Customer Success Manager (Digital Health & Pharmacy)
jobs.location: San Francisco Bay Area, CA, USA
jobs.description:
Develop Health is on a mission to use AI to radically accelerate access to life-saving medications. By automating complex, manual healthcare processes—like benefit verification and prior authorization— **we've been growing rapidly and over the past couple of years have helped over 3.6 million patients!**

We’re partnering with some of the largest pharmacy benefit managers and payers in the nation, revolutionizing how healthcare interactions occur by eliminating human delays and inefficiencies. Our small, elite team of founders and engineers have previously launched and exited successful healthcare startups including Rupa Health and Canvas Medical. We are now scaling rapidly following a major funding round.

**About The Role**
------------------

We're hiring a **Strategic Customer Success Manager** to own our largest digital health and pharmacy accounts after they sign.

This role doesn't carry a quota. You're measured on retention, renewals, and volume growth from your accounts, and you'll work closely with product and engineering.

Day to day, you'll set success criteria with each customer, catch risk early from usage data, and find where accounts can grow. As we add customers, you'll also build the account plans and QBR templates the rest of the team will use.

You don't need a healthcare background, but you need to learn a complex domain quickly.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

**Own a book of strategic accounts**

* Be the main post-sale contact for our highest-value digital health and pharmacy customers.
* Agree on success criteria with each account and track them.
* Run QBRs that tie platform performance (approval rates and turnaround time) to the customer's own goals.

**Protect and grow revenue**

* Spot at-risk accounts early from usage and support data, and run the plan to turn them around.
* Own renewals and find room to expand, like more volume or new sites.
* Work with our account executives when an expansion needs a commercial conversation.

**Be the customer's voice inside Develop Health**

* Bring patterns from your accounts to product and engineering, with a clear read on impact.
* Handle the complex escalations yourself, and route the rest to the right person.

**Build the playbook**

* Turn what works on your accounts into templates and processes the team can reuse.
* Help set how we score account health and when we step in.

**What You'll Bring On Day 1**
------------------------------

* **5+ years in a post-sale, account-owning role** (Customer Success, Account Management, Strategic AM) with a named book of business.
* **Retention and growth you can point to.** Renewals, NRR, saves, or volume growth on accounts you owned.
* **B2B experience.** Your customers were companies.
* **Proactive account work**. Account plans, success criteria, health scoring, and QBRs you ran yourself.
* **Comfort with data.** You read a dashboard and turn what changed into a plan.
* **Executive presence.** You're comfortable running a meeting with a customer's COO or head of pharmacy.

**What You'll Need To Learn Quickly**
-------------------------------------

* **Our domain:** prior authorization, benefit verification, PBMs and payers, and why they matter to our customers.
* **Our customers' businesses:** how a telehealth company or a pharmacy makes money, and where we fit.
* **Our product:** what it does well and where it's still improving.

**Bonus Points**
----------------

* Account management at a health-tech company selling to providers, telehealth companies, or pharmacies.
* Account management at a pharma manufacturer or pharma services company.
* Built a CS or AM function at an early-stage startup.
* Women's health, GLP-1, or weight-management telehealth accounts.
* Experience with CS tools (Pylon, Gainsight, Vitally) or light SQL.

**This Might Not Be The Right Fit If**
--------------------------------------

* You want a quota. New logos belong to our sales team.
* You prefer working a support queue. You'll handle hard escalations, and most of your time goes to account plans, renewals, and expansion.
* You want to manage people right away. This is an individual contributor role.
* You need a lot of structure. Building it is part of the job.

**What We Offer**
-----------------

* Competitive base salary plus meaningful early-stage equity.
* Health, dental, and vision coverage, 401k matching, plus flexible PTO.
* A clear path to a strategic book of accounts as we grow.
* Work that directly speeds up access to medication for hundreds of thousands of patients.

Compensation Range: $155K - $170K

===========================

Nooks is an applied AI lab building the Agent Workspace for GTM. We design AI agents that operate across the full sales action set, from account strategy to prospect research and outreach. Building 0 1 has never been easier, but selling at the speed of the market remains the last frontier for AI. Our mission is to 10x every seller by automating the busywork so they can focus on what humans do best: closing deals.

Today, over 2000 customers run on Nooks, including Notion, HubSpot, Cursor, and Rippling. We've raised over 70M USD from top VCs like Kleiner Perkins, and we've at least tripled ARR each year for 3 years running.

We’re hiring our first Customer Enablement professional to build Nooks University from the ground up. You’ll create the learning experiences that help customers onboard independently, build confidence using Nooks, and keep learning as our product evolves.

This is a senior, self-directed individual contributor role with broad ownership and hands-on execution. =====================

* 5+ years of experience in customer enablement at a high-growth SaaS company.

jobs.title: Case Manager
jobs.description:
3rd Street Youth Center & Clinic is a community-based agency providing youth in Bayview Hunters Point with medical and behavioral health services that encourage them to make decisions that support their health, safety, and development. 3rd Street also manages a number of successful Transitional Age Youth (TAY) housing stabilization programs and one of the city's few Youth Access Points.

The Transitional Living Program (TLP) provides a stable, supportive, and developmentally appropriate residential environment for justice-involved youth ages 18–27. The program focuses on safety, healing, accountability, and growth through a low-barrier and trauma-informed approach. Youth receive individualized support aimed at improving life skills, stabilizing housing, accessing behavioral health care, completing probation requirements, and moving toward long-term independence.

Housing is time-limited, for up to 36 months under HSH's TAY Transitional Housing Length of Stay Policy. The program serves youth who are exiting custody, have high needs and high use of the criminal justice system, have urgent or emergent health concerns, and are experiencing housing instability. Referrals come through the referral system HSH established for the Just Home Project.

**Position Summary**
--------------------

The Just Home Residential Case Manager provides housing education, workforce development, and trauma-informed case management to justice-involved transitional age youth (TAY) residing in the Transitional Living Program. The Case Manager carries a caseload of no more than 20 youth (1:20 ratio), completes intakes, risk/needs assessments, and Individualized Service Plans, supports youth in meeting probation and court requirements, and begins housing navigation and exit planning to move youth into permanent housing. The role works to reduce recidivism, strengthen community connections, and equip youth with the skills, resources, and guidance needed for educational and career success. Services are delivered in line with HSH requirements, Housing First, harm reduction, and trauma-informed practice, and success is measured against HSH outcome targets such as exits to permanent housing, employment or post-secondary enrollment, income gains, and probation compliance.The following is not a comprehensive listing of the activities, duties, or responsibilities required of the Case Manager. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change, or new ones may be assigned as needed.

### **Intake, Assessment & Service Planning**

* Initiate contact with each youth within two business days of an HSH referral. If a youth does not engage after three outreach attempts over twelve business days, include HSH and any relevant partner agency and request help re-engaging.
* Welcome and engage youth as they enter the program, and complete intake and program orientation within one business day of move-in, covering program length, roles and responsibilities, participant expectations, and available services.
* Conduct risk/needs assessments and assess each youth's strengths, skills, and needs using trauma-informed and restorative practices.
* Develop an Individualized Service Plan with each youth within 30 days of enrollment, covering housing, employment, benefits, and education, and review and update it at least once per month.
* Design individual support and transition plans with youth, including independent living skills and income stability.
* Refer any youth without an active Coordinated Entry assessment within six months of enrollment.

### **Case Management & Engagement**

* Hold a caseload of no more than 20 youth (1:20).
* Complete in-person check-ins at least once per week, including required room visits, scheduled case management meetings, and drop-in hours, and provide ongoing meetings and counseling toward each youth's goals.
* Support residents in meeting probation conditions, court requirements, pretrial release conditions, and diversion agreements, using reminders, transportation coordination, and connection to peer support.
* Develop individual recidivism prevention plans that identify triggers and provide intensive support during high-risk periods, using trauma-informed approaches that account for the links between justice involvement, housing instability, and mental health.
* Offer onsite services or referrals to youth showing signs of placement instability, such as loss of benefits, rule violations, conflicts with staff or other youth, or warnings from property or program management, and help de-escalate and resolve conflicts.
* Provide crisis intervention and safety planning as needed, and take part in the program's 24/7 de-escalation and conflict resolution coverage, including room checks, wellness checks, and emergency safety checks under the program protocol developed with HSH.
* Offer support and referrals related to behavioral health and substance use, and connect youth to wellness services, including health education, prenatal care, and parent-child attachment and education for parenting youth, in-house or by referral.
* Track resident progress, service utilization, and probation compliance.

### **Referrals & Coordination**

* Provide resource brokerage and referrals, including information about services, help setting appointments and completing applications, appointment reminders, follow-up, and re-referral as needed.
* Help youth obtain and keep benefits, including cash aid, food programs, Medi-Cal, and in-home support, and solve problems that block enrollment.
* Help ensure transportation, food, and clothing are not barriers to self-sufficiency, including clothing for job re-entry.
* Coordinate cases and advocate for youth within the agency and with other community-based organizations, and support youth's existing community linkages.
* Collaborate with probation and parole officers through case conferencing to set supervision approaches that prioritize stability and growth, and work with the District Attor

jobs.title: Senior People Partner
jobs.description:
**About the role**

Genesis brings together AI research, simulation, and robotics to build general-purpose robots that can work in the real world. Our mission is to unlock unlimited physical labor.

Building that company takes more than hiring exceptional people. It takes clear expectations, strong managers, honest feedback, and an organization that helps people do their best work.

You’ll partner closely with leaders and teams to make that happen. You’ll help managers navigate difficult decisions, build the people practices we need as we grow, and stay close enough to the work to know whether those practices are actually helping.

This is a role for someone who can discuss organizational design with a leader in the morning and work through a sensitive employee situation in the afternoon. Strong judgment, practical execution, and trust matter equally.

**What you’ll own**

* **Being a trusted partner to leaders.** Understand their priorities, challenge their thinking when needed, and translate business goals into clear decisions about teams, capabilities, and headcount.
* **Helping managers become better managers.** Coach on expectations, feedback, development, team dynamics, and difficult conversations. Give managers practical support they can use immediately.
* **Making performance and growth clear.** Build and run lightweight approaches to goal setting, performance reviews, calibration, and career development. Help people understand what good looks like and how to grow.
* **Supporting teams through change.** Partner on organizational design, evolving responsibilities, leadership transitions, and communication as the company scales.
* **Handling sensitive situations well.** Navigate employee concerns, conflict, and performance issues with fairness, discretion, and sound judgment, bringing in Legal or local specialists when needed.
* **Turning signals into action.** Combine employee feedback, people data, and your understanding of the business to identify retention risks and organizational friction early.
* **Making the employee experience coherent.** Work with Recruiting, People Operations, Finance, and Legal to connect hiring, onboarding, development, compensation decisions, and transitions.

**You’ll thrive here if**

* You’ve independently partnered with senior leaders as a People Partner or HR Business Partner in a demanding, fast-growing environment.
* You earn trust with technical teams through preparation, direct communication, and consistent follow-through.
* You’ve coached managers through real performance, development, and employee relations situations.
* You can build a people practice from scratch and take responsibility for running it.
* You balance empathy with clear expectations and are comfortable addressing difficult issues early.
* You use data to sharpen your judgment while staying attentive to the context behind the numbers.
* You know when to act independently and when a situation needs specialist advice.

**Bonus points**

* You’ve supported engineering, research, AI, robotics, or other deeply technical teams.
* You’ve worked across France, the UK, and the US.
* You’ve helped a startup introduce its first performance, career, or manager development frameworks.
* You’ve supported a company through rapid international growth.

**The offer**

* Competitive base salary plus meaningful equity.
* Visa sponsorship and relocation support.
* Hybrid: 3–4+ days per week in our office.
* The opportunity to shape how a frontier AI and robotics company develops its people, supports its managers, and grows its organization.

Genesis is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome people with different backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives.

jobs.title: Stop Loss Training Lead
jobs.description:
Overview:

**Who We Are**

**Because health is personal.** That's why Personify Health created the first and only personalized health platform—bringing health plan administration, holistic wellbeing solutions, and comprehensive care navigation together in one place. We serve employers, health plans, and health systems with data-driven solutions that reduce costs while actually improving health outcomes. Together, our team is on a mission to empower people to lead healthier lives.

Learn even more about the work that drives us at personifyhealth.com.

Responsibilities:

#### **Ready to be the go-to expert who turns stop loss complexity into reimbursement wins?**

**Why This Role Matters**

Every self-funded plan we serve depends on getting stop loss right, and that starts with someone who knows the contracts inside and out. As Stop Loss Lead, you’re the department’s technical authority, the person who makes sure eligible reimbursements get submitted, tracked, and collected instead of left on the table. Your audits catch problems early, your training makes the whole team sharper, and your process improvements make every claim move faster and cleaner. The stronger your expertise and the quality of your work, the stronger our reimbursement outcomes, our client relationships, and the department as a whole.

**What You’ll Actually Do**

* **Serve as the stop loss authority:** Act as the department’s subject matter expert on administration, reimbursement, and contract interpretation, giving the team a trusted source for answers on complex questions.
* **Dig into contracts and carrier requirements:** Review stop loss contracts, plan documents, and carrier requirements in depth to ensure compliance and capture every reimbursement opportunity available.
* **Drive reimbursements to resolution:** Support the submission, tracking, and reconciliation of stop loss claims, and work aging items, carrier inquiries, disputes, and escalated cases through to closure.
* **Audit for quality:** Conduct regular reviews of claim submissions, reimbursement tracking, documentation, and correspondence to confirm accuracy and completeness, then report results and performance metrics to leadership.
* **Turn findings into fixes:** Spot recurring errors, trends, and process gaps in audit results, develop corrective action recommendations, and partner with leadership to put them in place.
* **Build and coach the team:** Onboard new Stop Loss Specialists, create and maintain training materials and standard operating procedures, and deliver coaching and refresher sessions that close knowledge gaps.
* **Improve how we work:** Evaluate workflows, lead or support process improvement initiatives, and help roll out new tools and best practices, including testing and validating system updates.
* **Own reporting and audit readiness:** Review and help prepare monthly stop loss and reimbursement reporting and carrier submissions, support internal and external audit requests, and keep documentation accurate and current.
* **Step in where it counts:** Process stop loss claims and handle related operational work when workflow demands require it, and contribute to special projects that advance department goals.

  
Qualifications:

**What You Bring to Our Team**

**Education & Experience:**

* High School Diploma or equivalent required; Associate’s or Bachelor’s degree preferred
* 3-5 years of experience in stop loss, self-funded health plan administration, claims, or related healthcare required
* Advanced claims processing and reimbursement experience strongly preferred
* Experience interpreting stop loss contracts and plan documents preferred
* Experience conducting audits, quality reviews, or process improvement initiatives preferred
* Experience training or mentoring team members preferred

**Technical Skills:**

* Advanced knowledge of stop loss administration, reimbursement processes, and contract interpretation
* Working knowledge of medical terminology and CPT, HCPCS, and ICD-10 coding (preferred)
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Word, Outlook, and reporting tools
* Auditing and data analysis skills, including identifying trends and building data-driven recommendations

**Benefits**

**The Highlights:**

* Competitive base salary and benefits effective day one
* Comprehensive medical and dental through our own health solutions (yes, we use what we build)
* Unlimited PTO—rest and recharge time is non-negotiable
* Mental health support, retirement planning, and financial protection
* Professional development with clear career progression and learning budgets
* Mission-driven culture where diverse perspectives drive real impact on people's health

**Want the full picture?** Visit personifyhealthbenefits.com to explore our complete benefits package, wellness programs, and other employee perks.

**Compensation:** This position offers a base salary range of $65,000 - $73,000, depending on location, skills, and experience. You're eligible for our full benefits package starting day one.

**Our Commitment:** Personify Health is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging. We cultivate a work environment where differences are celebrated, and employees of all backgrounds are empowered to thrive—because diversity is core to who we are and critical to our work in health and wellbeing.

**Stay Safe:** Personify Health will never ask for payment or sensitive personal information like social security numbers during hiring. Evaluate warehouse, transportation, distribution, packaging, material flow, and inbound/outbound logistics capabilities; identify capacity gaps and corrective actions  

  

**Operational Excellence**

* Facilitate structured problem-solving using methods such as A3, DMAIC, 5 Whys, fishbone analysis, Pareto analysis, and root cause/corrective action

jobs.description:
The Utilities Infrastructure Project Manager (Wastewater) delivers Havenpark’s wastewater infrastructure projects, including wastewater treatment plants, collection systems, tanks, and drainage, on budget and by the budgeted completion dates. The role owns each assigned project from scope definition through closeout, managing the engineers and contractors to completion. The wastewater portfolio currently includes about 53 open projects totaling $9.5 million.

This role is accountable for completion. Community managers and Regional Vice Presidents (RVP) stay informed and partner on access and communication, but they are not responsible for finishing the work. The Sr. Utilities Program Manager sets priorities and selects projects and also owns compliance, operators, and utility emergency response, so this role can stay focused on projects.

On critical projects and others that need an engineer for design and construction, the position manages the engineers and holds them to scope, schedule, and cost. It reinforces Havenpark’s values and purpose-driven culture of creating caring communities.

### **Project Planning & Delivery**

* Own a portfolio of wastewater projects from scope definition through closeout, finishing each on budget and on schedule, with no projects past due.
* Define scope fully before bidding, including what is and is not included, so contractors price and plan the real work and change requests are rare.
* Build the plan up front: lead times, agency review times, access and seasonal constraints, and potential start delays. Start early enough to finish on time.
* Maintain project plans, milestones, and budgeted completion dates in project management software; flag risks early and recover projects that go past due.
* Visit project sites as needed, and verify that work is actually complete and ready before marking a project complete.
* Close out projects with final documentation, as-builts, warranties, and lessons learned.

### **Contractor & Engineer Management**

* Manage engineers and contractors to completion on every assigned project, holding them accountable for quality, safety, schedule, and cost.
* Walk contractors through the scope and schedule before they start and confirm their understanding in writing; manage bids, contracts, and change orders; and compare change requests against the survey, scope, and drawings before approving.
* Engage engineers for design and construction on critical projects and other projects that require engineering; define their scopes of work, review designs and cost estimates, and review invoices and progress reports.

### **Permitting & Regulatory Coordination**

jobs.title: Senior Project Manager
jobs.description:
About Veksel

Veksel Consulting and Contracting is helping shape the future of digital infrastructure by delivering the expertise and leadership behind some of North America's most complex hyperscale and AI programs. Operating as an integrated extension of our owner's representative clients' organizations, we unite development, power strategy, design management, construction leadership, and commissioning expertise to turn ambitious infrastructure goals into reality.

Position Summary

Veksel is seeking an experienced **Senior Project Manager** to lead the day-to-day execution of complex construction projects, ensuring work is delivered safely, on schedule, within budget, and in accordance with quality standards and client expectations.

Key Responsibilities

**Project Leadership & Execution**

* Lead projects from preconstruction and procurement through construction, commissioning, and closeout.
* Establish project execution plans, objectives, milestones, and priorities.
* Coordinate with clients, owners, design teams, senior leadership, subcontractors, and vendors.
* Provide regular project updates, forecasts, and performance reports.

  

**Schedule & Cost Management**

* Manage project schedules, critical path activities, milestones, and deliverables.
* Coordinate subcontractor sequencing and develop recovery plans when needed.
* Oversee project budgets, cost forecasts, invoices, change orders, and financial reporting.
* Identify schedule and cost risks early and implement effective mitigation strategies.

  

**Construction & MEP Coordination**

* Coordinate civil, structural, architectural, mechanical, electrical, plumbing, and other construction disciplines.
* Partner with Superintendents and field teams to resolve construction challenges.
* Review drawings, specifications, RFIs, submittals, and change documentation.
* Support commissioning, testing, startup, and final project turnover.

  

**Subcontractor, Quality & Safety Management**

* Manage subcontractor and vendor relationships, performance, and contractual obligations.
* Lead project coordination meetings and ensure timely resolution of action items.
* Promote a strong safety culture and ensure compliance with OSHA, client, and project-specific requirements.
* Monitor quality assurance and quality control activities and drive timely correction of deficiencies.
* Maintain accurate project documentation and proactively manage project risks.

  

**Client & Stakeholder Relationships**

* Serve as a key point of contact for clients and project stakeholders.
* Communicate project status, financial performance, schedule impacts, and emerging risks.
* Build trusted relationships and resolve issues while keeping projects moving forward.

  

**Preconstruction Design Support**

* Participate in design coordination meetings
* Review BOD issues/changes against project schedules and budgets
* Provide constructability feedback.

  

Qualifications

  

* Minimum of a High School Diploma or GED, required.
* 7+ years of construction or project management experience.
* Demonstrated success managing complex construction projects, preferably valued at $50 million or more.
* Experience in large-scale commercial, industrial, mission-critical, or data center construction.
* Strong knowledge of construction scheduling, budgeting, procurement, contract administration, and subcontractor management.
* Experience coordinating multiple construction disciplines, including mechanical and electrical systems.
* Ability to interpret construction drawings, specifications, and contracts.
* Proficiency with construction management and scheduling tools such as Procore, Primavera P6, Bluebeam, Microsoft Project, or similar platforms.
* Excellent leadership, communication, organization, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, high-accountability project environment.

  

Preferred Qualifications

  

* Data center or other mission-critical construction experience.
* Experience supporting hyperscale data center clients or developers.
* Experience with commissioning, startup, and turnover of mission-critical facilities.
* Bachelor's degree in Construction Management, Engineering, or a related field.
* PMP, CCM, or another relevant construction or project management certification.
* Experience working with large general contractors, construction managers, and major subcontractors.

  

*Equal Employment Opportunity*

*Veksel is an equal opportunity employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to protected characteristics under applicable federal, state, or local law. Reasonable accommodations are available to qualified applicants with disabilities during the hiring process.*

Veksel Consulting & Contracting does not accept unsolicited resumes, candidate submissions, or recruiting services from third-party staffing agencies, recruiters, or vendors in connection with this position. Unsolicited submissions will not create any obligation for fees or compensation. We also ask that vendors refrain from solicitation related to this posting.

jobs.title: Regional Quality Manager
jobs.description:
At the interface of design, engineering and supply logistics, REHAU Automotive and SRG Global combine to form RESRG - a leading global supplier of coated exterior systems and components. With a combined track record of over 160 years across four continents and 22 production sites, RESRG's 10,000 skilled team members manufacture the latest exterior systems and components for the world's leading automotive manufacturers.
  
  
RESRG Automotive is seeking you to join our team as a Regional Quality Manager!
  
  
Your Job
  
The Regional Quality Manager is responsible for improving manufacturing quality performance across multiple plant locations. This is a hands-on, plant-facing role focused on establishing common quality standards, strengthening problem-solving capability, and driving sustainable improvements in scrap, waste, defects, and cost of poor quality.
  
The Quality Manager will work directly with plant Quality, Operations, Engineering, and Manufacturing teams to identify systemic issues, implement common processes, and build the capability of site teams to solve problems at the root cause.
  
This position will spend significant time within the manufacturing facilities, working alongside plant teams to improve processes and ensure successful practices are replicated across the region.
  
  
What You Will Do in Your Role
  

* Establish and deploy common quality standards and expectations across manufacturing locations.
* Identify best practices within individual plants and standardize them across the region.
* Improve consistency in quality processes, documentation, reporting, and manufacturing controls.
* Support compliance with IATF 16949, customer-specific requirements, and internal quality standards.
* Partner with plant leadership to identify quality risks and close systemic gaps.
* Build plant capability in structured problem-solving methodologies, including 8D, A3, 5 Why, Fishbone, and root cause analysis.
* Coach Quality Managers, Engineers, Operations leaders, and frontline teams on effective problem solving.
* Facilitate complex or recurring problem-solving activities when additional regional support is needed.
* Ensure corrective actions address true root causes and are sustained over time.
* Create mechanisms to share lessons learned and prevent repeat issues across facilities.
* Lead cross-functional initiatives to reduce scrap, rework, defects, waste, and Cost of Poor Quality (COPQ).
* Use quality and operational data to identify the largest opportunities for improvement.
* Support plant locations in developing measurable improvement plans and tracking results.
* Identify recurring issues across locations and drive regional countermeasures.
* Partner with Operations and Engineering to eliminate quality-related process waste.
* Spend significant time at plant locations assessing processes and supporting improvement activity.
* Provide hands-on support for significant quality or manufacturing issues.
* Assist plants with customer complaints, containment, corrective actions, and systemic quality issues.
* Support APQP, PPAP, PFMEA, Control Plans, SPC, MSA, and Layered Process Audits where needed.
* Help underperforming sites establish disciplined quality improvement plans.

Who You Are (Basic Qualifications)
  

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Quality, Manufacturing, or related field preferred.
* 7+ years of progressive quality experience in a manufacturing environment.
* Strong automotive manufacturing experience.
* Demonstrated experience leading structured problem-solving and continuous improvement activities.
* Strong working knowledge of IATF 16949 and automotive core tools, including APQP, PPAP, PFMEA, Control Plans, SPC, and MSA.
* Demonstrated ability to reduce scrap, defects, waste, and cost of poor quality.
* Ability to coach and influence plant teams without relying solely on direct reporting authority.
* Strong analytical and data-driven decision-making skills.
* Ability to travel regularly among regional manufacturing facilities.

What Will Put You Ahead
  

* Experience supporting multiple manufacturing locations.
* Experience with injection molding, paint, plating, or automotive exterior components.
* Six Sigma Green Belt/Black Belt, ASQ certification, or equivalent structured problem-solving experience.
* VDA 6.3 experience.

Our Benefits
  
Our goal is for each employee, and their families, to live fulfilling and healthy lives. We provide essential resources and support to build and maintain physical, financial, and emotional strength - focusing on overall wellbeing so you can focus on what matters most. Our benefits plan includes - medical, dental, vision, flexible spending and health savings accounts, life insurance, ADD, disability, retirement, paid vacation/time off, educational assistance, paid parental leave and adoption assistance. Specific eligibility criteria is set by the applicable Summary Plan Description, policy or guideline and benefits may vary by geographic region. If you have questions on what benefits apply to you, please speak to your recruiter.
  
  
Equal Opportunities
  
Equal Opportunity Employer, including disability and protected veteran status. Except where prohibited by state law, some offers of employment are conditioned upon successfully passing a drug test. This employer uses E-Verify.

jobs.title: Manager, Workforce Management

**Job Description**

***A bit about this role:***

Within the Member Experience Operations team, the Workforce Management function is responsible for ensuring operating teams are staffed to deliver on the world-class service Devoted is known for. Our focus is on delivering on Devoted’s promise to “treat members like family” by ensuring each team has the right support each day to serve our members and patients, and on making Devoted a welcoming and sustainable place to work.

That’s where you come in. The Manager for Workforce Management will play a crucial role in building, overseeing, and optimizing workforce planning and operations.

This role is a great fit for someone who is analytical, hands-on, and energized by building practical solutions in a fast-moving environment. You'll work closely with WFM and operations leadership to put workforce management systems and processes in place, and you'll be the person who makes sure they actually run well every day.

***Your Responsibilities and Impact will include:***

* **Own scheduling and capacity for teams:** set the approach for how staff supply is matched to member demand across teams. Make sure the right staff are in the right places to meet access and budget targets.
* **Oversee daily capacity health:** review supply and demand everyday. Step in to help the team respond quickly when the day doesn’t go to plan. Make decisions around how to recover from supply deficits.
* **Drive daily operations in real time:** Monitor intraday performance (i.e.: SLA attainment, AHT, shrinkage). Make real-time adjustments to ensure service levels and appointment completion targets are met.
* **Maintain accurate schedules:** own the processes and systems that keep schedules and calendars accurate as availability changes. That includes time off, non-clinical time, weekend coverage, and other schedule changes. Balance employee needs with coverage impact, partnering with people leaders on time-off decisions. Manage PTO approval process.
* **Lead capacity planning and oversight:** track staffing against plan and flag early when supply won’t support targets. Act as a key input to Operations and Finance on hiring, backfill, and budget decisions.
* **Help build scalable processes:** create SOPs and playbooks so processes are repeatable as we grow. Look for opportunities to improve tools, workflows, and scheduling products, and partner with product and data teams to bring them to life.
* **Work cross functionally:** partner with Operations, Finance, Training, and clinical leadership to align staffing with budget and care delivery needs. Serve as the go-to leader for workforce management questions.

***Required skills and experience:***

* **Operational Experience:** 3+ years in workforce management, operations, or a related analytical role, ideally in a fast-paced startup environment.
* **Startup Mindset:** Transparent, adaptable, and comfortable operating in dynamic, rapidly changing conditions.
* **Systems Thinker:** someone who can build out sustainable systems by which we operate
* **People-First Approach:** Approaches every project with empathy and respect; a dedicated collaborator who ensures operational outcomes prioritize the well-being of the team and the success of the customer.

**﻿About frame Security:**

**﻿**Cyber threats have evolved to AI speed—legacy security training is dead. While old-school vendors push generic, tick-the-box videos, modern attacks are hyper-targeted, deepfake-driven, and evolving daily.

At Frame Security, we’re setting a new standard. Our AI-native platform learns an organization’s unique DNA—its tech stack, policies, and real-world risk—to deploy personalized, hyper-realistic simulations in minutes. From developers practicing secure coding to finance teams defending against AI voice phishing, we build adaptive defense systems for modern teams.

Why join us? We aren't building another static content library; we’re building the future of human defense against AI threats. If you want to solve hard problems and help shape a category-defining company, you belong here.

**Who are we looking for?**

We are looking for a technical powerhouse with zero ego to join us as a Technical Account Manager (TAM), supporting prospects and customers across Latin America (LATAM).

This isn’t a standard sales TAM role—you’ll be our technical secret weapon across the entire customer journey. One day you’re partnering with Sales to crush a technical evaluation or Proof of Value (POV); the next, you’re live-troubleshooting with a prospect or partnering with Customer Success to ensure our enterprise customers get maximum value from Frame.

You don’t need a cybersecurity background, but you do need rock-solid technical fundamentals, unstoppable curiosity, and a knack for explaining complex technical concepts clearly in both English and Spanish. If you love jumping into the deep end to solve real problems—rather than trying to be the smartest person in the room—we want to talk to you.

* Troubleshoot live issues, lead technical workshops, and break down technical roadblocks.

* Partner for Growth: Work closely with Sales, Customer Success, Product, and Engineering to deliver a seamless customer experience from demo to renewal.

**﻿Success Metrics:**

* Revenue closed
* Customer renewals & expansion
* Achievement of company revenue and retention goals

  
Requirements:  
  

**﻿Required Skills & Experience:**

* **2–5 years** in a customer-facing technical role (Sales/Solutions Engineer, TAM, Customer Success Engineer, or similar).
* **Language Fluency:** Fluent in English and Spanish, with strong written and verbal communication skills in both languages and the ability to lead technical discussions, demos, troubleshooting sessions, and customer workshops in either language.

**﻿Benefits:**

* Medical, dental and vision insurance.
* Monthly connectivity reimbursement.
* Unlimited paid time off.
* 401(K) Retirement Savings Plan.

**﻿Why frame:**

* High Impact: Build and own processes from start to finish that directly impact our product and customers, affecting millions of people.
* Early-Stage Advantage: Join at the ground floor of a category-defining company. The decisions you make today will shape how the world thinks about Human Security tomorrow.

jobs.description:
**The Opportunity**

We are a national leader in pavement maintenance and infrastructure services with aggressive growth targets, active M&A activity, and a platform built to win large enterprise relationships across the country. The National Account Manager excels at managing complex sales cycles, multi-site program management, and relentless new business development.

This is both a relationship-management role and a hunter-builder position. You will land and expand national accounts across high-value verticals and act as the commercial face of our platform for the country's largest facility operators. **This is a role to build, not simply to maintain** - National Accounts is where this company's growth will be won.

**What You Will Own**

**New National Account Growth**

* Own a named target list of enterprise prospects across retail, logistics, industrial, healthcare, hospitality, and commercial real estate - driving them through the pipeline with urgency and consistency
* Build and execute outbound prospecting strategies including direct outreach, industry networking, broker and GPO channel relationships, and referral development
* Lead full-cycle complex sales from first contact through signed MSA - including discovery, site assessment, multi-location scoping, pricing, and contract close
* Hit and exceed quarterly new-logo targets; document all activity, pipeline, and stage movement in CRM with precision

**National Account Expansion**

* Once accounts are landed, develop expansion strategies to grow wallet share across additional locations, service lines, and capital programs
* Match effort to opportunity - invest in deep, multi-year programs for the highest-value accounts, and manage the rest of the portfolio with proportionate rigor rather than treating every account the same
* Build multi-year pavement management programs - condition assessments, CapEx planning, preventative maintenance schedules, and ADA compliance roadmaps - that lock in long-term partnerships
* Conduct quarterly and annual business reviews with executive-level stakeholders, presenting performance data, program outcomes, and growth recommendations
* Identify and pursue upsell and cross-sell opportunities within active accounts

**Program Processing & Operational Scalability**

* Inform the design of national account processes - intake, onboarding, SLA frameworks, hand-off protocols - bringing the field insight that makes them work, and following them consistently once set
* Partner with regional operations leaders to ensure national program standards are met consistently across every market
* Drive continuous improvement in how national accounts are processed, tracked, reported, and renewed - building repeatable systems that scale with our growth
* Manage contract compliance, program KPIs, and customer reporting with a high degree of operational rigor

**Commercial Leadership**

* Lead all pricing, contract negotiations, and MSA execution for national accounts - balancing competitive positioning with margin discipline
* Respond to RFPs and national bid opportunities with compelling, differentiated proposals
* Maintain a deep understanding of competitive dynamics, procurement trends, and customer needs to sharpen our national go-to-market approach
* Feed market intelligence and customer feedback directly into leadership to inform pricing, product, and M&A strategy

**Who You Are**

You have a proven track record closing and growing national, multi-site enterprise accounts - ideally in pavement, facilities maintenance, commercial construction, outsourced services, or adjacent industries. You are as comfortable building pipeline from scratch as you are running a QBR with a VP of Real Estate. You bring urgency and accountability to everything you do, and you are energized by the chance to build something meaningful at a company with real momentum.

**Required**

* 5+ years of B2B enterprise or national account sales experience with documented revenue results
* Experience managing multi-million-dollar customer relationships across multiple locations or geographies
* Track record of new-logo acquisition and account expansion - not just account maintenance
* Experience selling construction, facilities, infrastructure, maintenance, or outsourced service solutions to enterprise buyers
* Skilled at navigating complex sales cycles involving procurement, facilities leadership, operations, finance, and the C-suite
* CRM fluency (Salesforce or equivalent) and strong pipeline-management discipline
* Ability to travel 25–50% nationally

**Preferred**

* Experience within the pavement, asphalt, concrete, or specialty contractor industries
* Familiarity with multi-site program management, national service-delivery models, and MSA structures
* Background working inside a high-growth, acquisition-oriented, or multi-market platform organization
* Enough technical fluency to discuss site conditions and scope credibly with a customer - or the aptitude to learn it quickly

**Physical Requirements**: (Each to have one of the following based on the position: Never, Rarely, Occasionally, Constantly)

* Remaining in a stationary position, often standing or sitting for prolonged periods: **Occasionally**
* Moving about to accomplish tasks at a worksite or moving from one worksite to another: **Constantly**
* Moving self in different positions to accomplish tasks in various environments, such as stooping, kneeling, or crouching: **Rarely**
* Adjusting, moving and lifting objects in all directions: **Rarely**
* Talking and hearing to communicate with others: **Constantly**
* Seeing to perform job duties at close range, such as monitors or screens: **Constantly**
* Seeing to perform job duties at a distance, such as driving or operating equipment: **Occasionally**

jobs.title: Care Advocate I
jobs.description:
Color Health is revolutionizing cancer care with the nation’s first Virtual Cancer Clinic, delivering high-quality, physician-led multidisciplinary care across all 50 states. Our innovative, guideline-based approach spans cancer screening, risk assessment, prevention, diagnosis, treatment support, and survivorship. In addition to personalized direct medical care, our services include cancer genetics risk assessment, nutrition, mental health support and at-home cancer screening diagnostics. Using technology-driven, patient-centric solutions, Color is transforming how employers, unions, health plans, and governments address cancer. Color’s goal is to close critical cancer care gaps, improve cancer outcomes, and guide patients with empathy through their healthcare journeys.

Apply to join Color and do the most meaningful work of your career. If you are not sure that you’re 100% qualified but are up for the challenge - we want you to apply!

**About the Role**

As a Care Advocate I at Color, you will play a critical role in helping patients navigate complex healthcare journeys, ensuring they receive the care, guidance, and support they need.

You will serve as a primary point of contact and trusted partner for patients navigating cancer screening, abnormal results, elevated cancer risk, active cancer treatment, and survivorship. You will build meaningful relationships with patients, understand their individual needs, and help them overcome barriers to accessing high-quality care.

This role combines personalized patient advocacy with hands-on healthcare navigation and care coordination. You will help patients identify appropriate providers and facilities, coordinate referrals and appointments, navigate insurance and benefits, and stay on track with recommended care. You’ll also provide ongoing encouragement, education, and support to help patients feel informed, empowered, and confident in their next steps.

As part of a growing health technology company, you’ll need to be resourceful, tech-savvy, and adaptable. We’re looking for someone who can balance compassionate, high-touch patient care with efficiency, strong organizational skills, and a continuous improvement mindset.

**How You'll Contribute:**

**Patient Relationships & Advocacy**

* Serve as a primary point of contact and trusted advocate for patients navigating complex healthcare journeys, including abnormal results, elevated cancer risk, active treatment, and survivorship.
* Build meaningful patient relationships through empathetic communication, personalized guidance, and proactive engagement.
* Help patients overcome barriers to care, make informed decisions, and stay motivated and on track with recommended care.

**Healthcare Navigation & Care Coordination**

* Coordinate all aspects of patient care, including identifying high-quality providers and facilities, managing referrals, scheduling appointments, and facilitating follow-ups.
* Proactively track patient progress, resolve barriers or delays, and ensure timely follow-through on care needs.
* Collaborate with Color’s clinical teams and external providers to coordinate care, communicate updates, and escalate concerns appropriately.

**Insurance & Benefits Navigation**

* Verify insurance eligibility, benefits, and coverage, helping patients understand their options and potential costs.
* Coordinate prior authorizations, referrals, and financial assistance while troubleshooting insurance or administrative barriers to care.

**Operational Excellence & Continuous Improvement**

* Manage a portfolio of patients and care coordination tasks, balancing high-quality patient support with efficiency, productivity, and timely follow-through.

jobs.description:
**Job Description**

***A bit about this role:***

Our member and prospect-facing teams help people navigate the complex world of health care by genuinely listening to their questions and guiding them towards the best decisions for their healthcare needs. As a Workforce Management Real Time Analyst, you have the opportunity to help us optimize capacity planning for a rapidly scaling service, outreach, and sales team nationwide.

In this role, you will be responsible for managing the inbound queue for our Member Service Guide (MSG), Telesales, and inbound and outbound Member Outreach teams using Devoted’s workforce management (WFM) and contact center platforms to ensure our front line teams can support our members. You will create standard operating procedures based on the forecasted inbound call volume and partner closely with other Member Experience and Health Plan Operations teams to ensure there is sufficient support for frontline teams to meet Devoted’s service metrics on a daily basis. You will be expected to proactively identify areas of improvement based on data and insights. This role is critical to improving the Devoted experience for both frontline teams and members alike.

* **Support WFM:** Support other areas of WFM as needed

* **Technical Knowledge:** Experience with WFM and Telephony systems.
* **Google Suite Proficiency:** Experience with Google Suite (specifically Sheets).

The actual base salary offered will depend on a variety of factors, including the qualifications of the individual applicant for the position, years of relevant experience, specific and unique skills, level of education attained, certifications or other professional licenses held, and the location in which the applicant lives and/or from which they will be performing the job.

About RoundPoint Mortgage Servicing LLC
  
RoundPoint Mortgage Servicing LLC is a fully integrated, non-bank mortgage company, with a subservicing portfolio of approximately 00,000 loans. In 2023, RoundPoint was acquired by Two Harbors Investment Corp. (NYSE: TWO), reaffirming its commitment to MSR as core and essential to our business strategy and our future. jobs.title: Atlassian Instructional Designer Level III
jobs.description:
Overview:

LMI is seeking an Instructional Designer at the Level III level to develop accessible, effective learning experiences supporting Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) Agile practices and Atlassian Cloud adoption. This role combines learning strategy, curriculum design, digital content development, and performance support to translate complex processes and tools into practical instruction for a diverse federal workforce.

The Instructional Designer will design role-based learning paths for leadership, Scrum Masters, Product Owners, delivery teams, and tool administrators. The position develops live-instruction materials, self-paced e-learning, hands-on exercises, job aids, assessments, and adoption-hub resources using ADDIE or SAM and tools such as Articulate Storyline and Rise. Content will be prepared for the existing learning management system and validated against accessibility requirements.

This is not a slide-production-only role. The designer must identify the performance problem behind a training request, define measurable learning objectives, test content with representative learners, and refine materials based on completion data and user feedback. The ideal candidate balances technical accuracy with adult-learning principles, concise writing, visual clarity, and Section 508 compliance.

LMI is a new breed of digital solutions provider dedicated to accelerating government impact with innovation and speed. Investing in technology and prototypes ahead of need, LMI brings commercial-grade platforms and mission-ready AI to federal agencies at commercial speed.

Leveraging our mission-ready technology and solutions, proven expertise in federal deployment, and strategic relationships, we enhance outcomes for the government, efficiently and effectively. With a focus on agility and collaboration, LMI serves the defense, space, healthcare, and energy sectors—helping agencies navigate complexity and outpace change. Headquartered in Tysons, Virginia, LMI is committed to delivering impactful results that strengthen missions and drive lasting value.

Responsibilities:

* Conduct needs analysis and translate assessed learner cohorts and job roles into measurable learning objectives.
* Design role-based courses on Agile practices, Jira Cloud, reporting, and administrative workflows using ADDIE or SAM.
* Develop instructor guides, presentations, demonstrations, exercises, assessments, e-learning modules, and concise job aids.
* Author and maintain Articulate Storyline or Rise content and package courses for SCORM-compatible LMS delivery.
* Coordinate publishing, course metadata, completion tracking, pilot testing, and revisions with LMS and training operations staff.
* Perform accessibility reviews and coordinate Section 508 and WCAG testing and remediation for self-paced content.
* Maintain consistent, version-controlled adoption-hub and knowledge-base resources.
* Create curriculum maps that connect learner role and readiness level to objectives, prerequisites, modality, activities, practice tasks, and knowledge checks.
* Script accurate Jira Cloud and Agile demonstrations with consistent terminology, realistic workflows, annotated screenshots, and accessible interaction patterns.
* Build facilitator notes, learner guides, scenario-based exercises, quick-reference cards, and assessment items that reinforce on-the-job application.
* Conduct editorial, functional, and accessibility quality assurance; document remediation decisions before course publication and updates.
* Manage content versions, review cycles, SME approvals, and content ownership so learning materials stay aligned with changing platform configurations.

Qualifications:

**Required:**

* Bachelor's degree in instructional design, education, learning technologies, educational psychology, or a related field.
* 3+ years of instructional design, e-learning development, or performance-support experience.
* Demonstrated use of ADDIE or SAM and Articulate Storyline or Rise.
* Experience with SCORM packages, LMS course publishing, and training evaluation.
* Knowledge of Section 508 and WCAG accessibility requirements and accessible content design.
* Ability to obtain and maintain a favorable Public Trust determination and satisfy applicable federal personnel vetting, security, privacy, accessibility, and data-handling requirements.
* Section 508 Trusted Tester certification or equivalent formal accessibility testing credential.
* Portfolio or work samples demonstrating both instructor-led design and interactive e-learning or digital performance support.
* Ability to collaborate with technical SMEs and translate detailed workflows into accurate, concise, and accessible learner-facing content.

**Desired:**

* Prior experience supporting the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA), Veterans Health Administration (VHA), or federal health programs is highly desirable.
* Master's degree in instructional design, education, learning technologies, or a related discipline.
* Agile, Jira Cloud, Confluence Cloud, or federal enterprise training experience.
* Experience creating blended learning for large distributed audiences.
* Experience designing simulation-based software instruction, formative assessments, and post-training performance reinforcement.
* Additional certifications such as ATD Associate Professional in Talent Development (APTD) or Certified Professional in Talent Development (CPTD) are desirable.

Target Salary Range: $85,000 - $115,000

The salary range displayed represents the typical salary range for this position and is not a guarantee of compensation. Individual salaries are determined by various factors including, but not limited to location, internal equity, business considerations, client contract requirements, and candidate qualifications, such as education, experience, skills, and security clearances.

new_jobs.title: Senior Data Operations Manager
new_jobs.description:
**About Genesis**
=================

We are a full-stack general-purpose robot company, born across San Francisco and Paris and bound by a single mission: to make general-purpose robots a reality, unlocking infinite physical labor for the world and freeing people for creativity, exploration, and the pursuits they love for their own sake.

We are French and American by birth and global by nature. We are backed by partners who share our vision, including Eclipse, Khosla Ventures, Bpifrance, and HSG, alongside Eric Schmidt, Xavier Niel, Daniela Rus, and Vladlen Koltun. Our people work across the Bay Area and Europe, building the engine that will teach robots to do real work in the real world. We recently unveiled Eno, our wheeled, dexterous robot powered by our GENE foundation model, and we are starting to put it to work with real customers.

**The role**
============

The hardest part of building general-purpose robots is not the model. It is the data: real, dexterous, physical-world manipulation that does not live on the internet. Our unlock is a data-collection glove built to the exact geometry of our robot hand, unobtrusive enough that a person can wear it through a normal workday, so ordinary work becomes training data that transfers to the robot without loss. Paired with our own hardware, simulation, and models in one tight loop, that is the most scalable manipulation data engine in the world.

This is the role that runs that engine on the ground. You will own the system that turns stations, workforce, and facilities into one reliable operation, end to end, from the operator at the station to the accepted hour that lands in training. You will grow it from a single floor into a global, multi-shift operation that holds a world-class quality bar as it scales. We are looking for someone who has run data collection at scale and is hungry to do it again at the frontier of physical AI.

**What you'll do**
==================

* **Run the floor end to end.** Own scheduling, operator utilization, station uptime, and the throughput that delivers accepted hours at the quality bar, every week.
* **Build the operator bench.** Recruit, level, and develop operators and the senior operators who run shifts, until the team is deep enough for multiple shifts and multiple sites.
* **Hold one standard everywhere.** Make every floor we run and every partner site collect to the same playbook, the same metrics, and the same bar.
* **Turn problems into process.** Root-cause what slows the floor and ship the SOPs, layouts, and tooling that make the next site ramp faster than the last.
* **Partner on quality and annotation.** Work hand in hand with the Quality and Process and Annotation functions so collected hours convert cleanly into training-ready data.
* **Stand up partner-site collection.** Rehearse and run the mock-runs and first deployments that bring partner operators onto our gear.
* **Report the truth.** Build the reporting that tells the company, honestly, what we collected, at what quality, and at what cost.

**What we're looking for**
==========================

* **You have built data collection at scale, and it shows.** You have run a teleoperation, glove, or human-data operation at a frontier robotics lab, an embodied-AI company, or a top data operation, and you know the difference between hours collected and hours that actually train a model. There is a short list of places this work happens. If you have done it, we want to talk.
* **Throughput is in your blood.** Scheduling, utilization, yield, and the hundred details of a working floor are second nature.
* **Quality is never optional.** You have run an operation where the bar was real and measured, and you held it without slowing the line.
* **You run through walls.** Bias for action, deep ownership, and a refusal to wait for permission. You see what needs doing and make it happen.
* **You build teams that win.** You hire well, coach honestly, and people do their best work for you.
* **You work across sites and cultures.** You are comfortable partnering with our teams and sites in Asia and Europe, and operating across time zones.

**How we work**
===============

We are always looking for people who are driven to work on hard problems and want to shape what the world will look like in ten years. A few of the values that guide us:

* **Limitless ambition.** We hold ourselves to the highest bar in everything we build.
* **Relentless urgency.** Iterate faster, learn faster. Time is the denominator.
* **Type-2 Fun.** Take the work seriously, not yourself. Embrace the grind and find joy in the struggle.
* **Radical transparency.** Candid communication builds trust, and direct feedback drives growth.
* **Multiculturalism.** We come from across the world. Be curious. Meet people on their terms.
* **Team over ego.** Help others, share context, and win as a team.
* **A joyful journey.** We take pride in the craft, enjoy the ride, and make space to laugh. Happiness is part of how we get there.
